H935.d: a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications).
H935.k: abide, apply, attain, X be, befall, + besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, X certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, X doubtless again, + eat, + employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, + follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, + have, X indeed, (in-)vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, X (well) stricken (in age), X surely, take (in), way

H938.d: the same as בּוּז ; Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite.

H939.d: feminine passive participle of בּוּז ; something scorned; an object of contempt.

H940.d: patronymic from בּוּז ; a Buzite or descendant of Buz.

H941.d: the same as בּוּזִי ; Buzi, an Israelite.

H942.d: probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite.

H943.d: a primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively).

H944.d: for יְבוּל ; produce (of the earth, etc.).

H945.d: the same as בוּל (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month.

H946.d: from בִּין ; discretion; Bunah, an Israelite.

H947.d: a primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively).

H948.d: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort).

H949.d: from the same as בּוּץ ; shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash.

H950.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective).

H951.d: properly, active participle from בָּקַר as denominative from בָּקָר ; a cattle-tender.

H952.d: a primitive root; to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine.

H953.d: from בּוּר (in the sense of בֹּארוֹת ); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison).

H954.d: a primitive root; properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed.
H954.k: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-)shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long

H955.d: feminine participle passive of בּוּשׁ ; shame.

H956.d: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from בַּיְתָא ; to lodge over night.

H958.d: a primitive root; probably to cleave.

H959.k: despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), + think to scorn, vile person

H962.k: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), X utterly

H964.d: from בָּזָה and יָהּ ; contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine.

H965.d: from an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lightning.

H966.d: from בָּזָק ; lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine.

H968.d: of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes.

H969.d: from בָּחַן ; an assayer or metals.

H970.d: or bachur ; participle passive of בָּחַר ; properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective).

H971.d: another form of בַּ֫חַן ; a watch-tower of besiegers.

H973.k: abhor, get hastily (from the margin for bahal )

H974.d: a primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate.

H975.d: from בָּחַן (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower.

H977.d: a primitive root; properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select.
H977.k: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require

H978.d: patrial from בַּחוּרִים (by transposition); a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim.

H979.d: or bchuwrowth ; feminine plural of בָּחוּר ; also (masculine plural) bchuriym ; youth (collectively and abstractly).

H980.d: or Bachuwriym ; masculine plural of בָּחוּר ; young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine.

H981.d: or batah ; a primitive root; to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily.

H982.d: a primitive root; properly, to hie for refuge (but not so precipitately as חָסָה ); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure.
H982.k: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust

H983.d: from בָּטַח ; properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely.
H983.k: assurance, boldly, (without) care(- less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely

H984.d: the same as בֶּ֫טַח ; Betach, a place in Syria.

H988.d: a primitive root; to desist from labor.

H990.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything.
H990.k: belly, body, + as they be born, + within, womb

H991.d: the same as בָּ֫טֶן ; Beten. a place in Palestine.

H992.d: from בָּ֫טֶן ; (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form).

H993.d: probably plural from בָּטְנִים ; hollows: Betonim, a place in Palestine.

H994.d: perhaps from בָּעָה (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with "my Lord"); Oh that!; with leave, or if it please.

H995.d: a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand.
H995.k: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man)

H996.d: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from בִּין ; a distinction; but used only as a prep, between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either..or..and), + from (the widest), X in, out of, whether (it be..or), within.

H998.k: knowledge, meaning, X perfectly, understanding, wisdom

H1000.d: from the same as בּוּץ ; an egg (from its whiteness).

H1002.d: of foreign origin; a castle or palace.

H1004.d: probably from בָּנָה abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.).
H1004.k: court, daughter, door, + dungeon, family, + forth of, X great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter)house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, + prison, + steward, + tablet, temple, web, + within(-out)

H1006.d: the same as בָּ֫יִת ; Bajith, a place in Palestine.

H1007.d: from בָּ֫יִת and אָ֫וֶן ; house of vanity; Beth- Aven, a place in Palestine.

H1008.d: from בָּ֫יִת and אֵל ; house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine.

H1009.d: from בָּ֫יִת and אָ֫רֶב and אֵל ; house of God's ambush; Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine.

H1010.d: from בָּ֫יִת and בַּ֫עַל and מָעוֹן ; house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) Beyth M own ; house of habitation of (Baal); Beth- Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine. Compare בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן and בְּעֹן .

H1011.d: from בָּ֫יִת and בָּרָא ; house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine.

H1012.d: probably from בָּ֫יִת and עֲבָרָה ; house of (the) ford; Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine.

H1013.d: from בָּ֫יִת and גָּדֵר ; house of (the) wall; Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine.

H1014.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the passive participle of גְּמוּל ; house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan.

H1015.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the dual of דְּבֵלִים ; house of (the) two figcakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan.

H1016.d: from בָּ֫יִת and דָּגוֹן ; house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine.

H1017.d: patrial from בֵּית־אֵל with the article interposed; a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel.

H1018.d: from בָּ֫יִת and אֵ֫צֶל with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine.

H1019.d: from בָּ֫יִת and הַגִּלְגָּל with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine.

H1020.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the plural of יַשִּׁ֫ימָ֫וֶת with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha- Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan.

H1021.d: from בָּ֫יִת and כָּ֫רֶם with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine.

H1022.d: patrial from בֵּית לָ֫חֶם with the article inserted; a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem.

H1023.d: from בָּ֫יִת and מֶרְחָק with the article interposed; house of the breadth; Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine.

H1024.d: or (shortened) Beyth Mar-kabowth ; from בָּ֫יִת and the plural of מֶרְכָּבָה (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots; Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine.

H1025.d: from בָּ֫יִת and עֵ֫מֶק with the article interposed; house of the valley; Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine.

H1026.d: from בָּ֫יִת and עֲרָבָה with the article interposed; house of the Desert; Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine.

H1027.d: from בָּ֫יִת and רוּם with the article interposed; house of the height; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan.

H1028.d: probably for בֵּית הָרָם ; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan.

H1029.d: from בָּ֫יִת and שִׁטִּים with the article interposed; house of the acacia; Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine.

H1030.d: patrial from בֵּית שָׁ֫מֶשׁ with the article inserted; a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh.

H1031.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the same as חָגְלָה ; house of a partridge; Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine.

H1032.d: from בָּ֫יִת and חֹר ; house of hollowness; Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine.

H1033.d: from בָּ֫יִת and כָּר ; house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine.

H1034.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the plural of לָבִיא ; house of lionesses; Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine. Compare לְבָאוֹת .

H1035.d: from בָּ֫יִת and לָ֫חֶם ; house of bread; Beth- Lechem, a place in Palestine.

H1036.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the feminine of עָפָר (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust; Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine.

H1037.d: or Beyth Mil-loh ; from בָּ֫יִת and מִלּוֹא ; house of (the) rampart; Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels.

H1038.d: from בָּ֫יִת and מַעֲכָה ; house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine.

H1039.d: from בָּ֫יִת and the feminine of נָמֵר ; house of (the) leopard; Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan. Compare נִמְרָה .

H1040.d: from בָּ֫יִת and עֲדָנִים ; house of pleasure; Beth-Eden, a place in Syria.

H1041.d: from בָּ֫יִת and עַזְמָ֫וֶת ; house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine. Compare עַזְמָ֫וֶת .

H1042.d: from בָּ֫יִת and a plural from עָנָה ; house of replies; Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine.

H1043.d: an orthographical variation for בֵּית עֲנוֹת ; Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine.

H1044.d: from בָּ֫יִת and a derivative of עָקַד ; house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing); Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine.

H1045.d: from בָּ֫יִת and עַשְׁתָּרוֹת ; house of Ashtoreths; Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine. Compare NONE , עַשְׁתָּרוֹת .

H1046.d: from בָּ֫יִת and פָּלִיט ; house of escape; Beth- Palet, a place in Palestine.

H1047.d: from בָּ֫יִת and פְּעוֹר ; house of Peor; Beth- Peor, a place East of the Jordan.

H1048.d: from בָּ֫יִת and a derivative from פּוּץ ; house of dispersion; Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine.

H1049.d: from בָּ֫יִת and צוּר ; house of (the) rock; Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine.

H1050.d: from בָּ֫יִת and רְחוֹב ; house of (the) street; Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine.

H1051.d: from בָּ֫יִת and רָפָא ; house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite.

H1052.d: or Beyth Shan ; from בָּ֫יִת and שָׁאַן ; house of ease; Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine.

H1053.d: from בָּ֫יִת and שָׁ֫מֶשׁ ; house of (the) sun; Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine.

H1054.d: from בָּ֫יִת and תַּפּ֫וּחַ ; house of (the) apple; Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine.

H1055.d: probably from בָּ֫יִת ; a palace (i.e. large house).

H1056.d: from בָּכָה , weeping; Baca, a valley in Palestine.

H1057.d: the same as הַבָּכָא ; the weeping tree (some gum- distilling tree, perhaps the balsam).

H1058.d: a primitive root; to weep; generally to bemoan.
H1058.k: X at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, X more, mourn, X sore, X with tears, weep

H1061.d: from בָּכַר ; the first-fruits of the crop.

H1062.d: or (short) bkorah ; feminine of בְּכוֹר ; the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture.

H1063.d: feminine of בִּכּוּרִים ; the early fig.

H1064.d: feminine of בְּכֹרָה ; primogeniture; Bekorath, an Israelite.

H1065.d: from בָּכָה ; a weeping; by analogy, a dripping.

H1066.d: plural active participle of בָּכָה ; (with the article) the weepers; Bo-kim, a place in Palestine.

H1067.d: feminine from בָּכַר ; the eldest daughter.

H1069.d: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from בִּכּוּרִים ) to give the birthright.
H1069.k: make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit)

H1070.d: from בָּכַר (in the sense of youth); a young camel.

H1071.d: the same as בִּכְרֵי ; Beker, the name of two Israelites.

H1072.d: feminine of בִּכְרֵי ; a young she-camel.

H1073.d: by orthographical variation for בִּכּוּרָה ; a first- ripe fig.

H1074.d: from בָּכַר ; first-born; Bokeru, an Israelite.

H1075.d: from בָּכַר ; youth-ful; Bikri, an Israelite.

H1076.d: patronymically from בָּ֫כֶר ; a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker.

H1077.d: from בָּלָה ; properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest..), not (any), nothing.

H1078.d: by contraction for בַּ֫עַל ; Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians.

H1079.d: (Aramaic) from בְּלָא ; properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat).

H1080.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּלָה (but used only in a mental sense); to afflict.

H1081.d: from בֵּל and אָדוֹן (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince.

H1082.d: a primitive root; to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction).

H1083.d: from בָּלַג ; desistance; Bilgah, the name of two Israelites.

H1084.d: from בָּלַג ; desistant; Bilgai, an Israelite.

H1085.d: of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends.

H1086.d: a primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend).
H1086.k: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste

H1088.d: feminine of בָּלִים ; failure; Balah, a place in Palestine.

H1089.d: a primitive root (rather by transposition for בָּהַל ); to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify.

H1090.d: from בָּלַהּ ; timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine.

H1092.d: from בָּלַהּ ; timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite.

H1093.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to בָּלָה ; excise (on articles consumed).

H1094.d: or (fully) blowy ; from בָּלָה ; (only in plural construction) rags.

H1095.d: of foreign derivation; Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel.

H1097.d: from בָּלָה ; properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc. .is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.
H1097.k: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no

H1098.d: from בָּלַל ; mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle).

H1099.d: from בְּלִי and מָה ; (as indef.) nothing whatever.

H1100.d: from בְּלִי and יָעַל ; without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness (often in connection with אּישׁ , נָשִׁים , בֵּן , etc.).

H1101.d: a primitive root; to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; also (denominatively from בְּלִיל ) to fodder.
H1101.k: anoint, confound, X fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper

H1103.d: a primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them).

H1104.d: a primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy.
H1104.k: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up)

H1105.d: from בָּלַע ; a gulp; figuratively, destruction.
H1105.k: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up

H1106.d: the same as בֶּ֫לַע ; Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites.

H1107.d: or balmadey ; constructive plural from בַּל and עַד , not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb) except, without, besides.

H1108.d: patronymically from בָּ֫לַע : a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela.

H1109.d: probably from בַּל and עָם ; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine.

H1111.d: from בָּלַק ; waster; Balak, a Moabitish king.

H1112.d: or Belshatstsar ; of foreign origin (compare בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר ); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king.

H1114.d: of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite.

H1115.d: constructive feminine of בָּלָה (equivalent to בְּלִי ); properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.
H1115.k: because un(satiable), beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without

H1116.d: from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation.

H1117.d: the same as בָּמָה ; Bamah, a place in Palestine. See also בָּמוֹת .

H1118.d: probably from מָהַל with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite.

H1119.d: prolongation for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.

H1120.d: plural of בָּמָה ; heights; or (fully) Bamowth Bahal ; from the same and בַּ֫עַל ; heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan.

H1121.d: from בָּנָה ; a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like אָב , אָח , etc.)).
H1121.k: + afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-)ite, (anoint-)ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-)ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, X came up in, child, colt, X common, X corn, daughter, X of first, + firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, X in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people, + rebel, + robber, X servant born, X soldier, son, + spark, + steward, + stranger, X surely, them of, + tumultuous one, + valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth

H1122.d: the same as בֵּן ; Ben, an Israelite.

H1124.d: (Aramaic) or bnah (Aramaic); corresponding to בָּנָה ; to build.

H1125.d: from בֵּן and אֲבִימֶ֫לֶך ; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite.

H1126.d: from בֵּן and אָ֫וֶן ; son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin.

H1127.d: from בֵּן and גָּ֫בֶר ; son of (the) hero; Ben- Geber, an Israelite.

H1128.d: from בֵּן and a derivative of דָּקַר ; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-Deker, an Israelite.

H1129.d: a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively).
H1129.k: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), X surely

H1130.d: from בֵּן and הֲדָד ; son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings.

H1131.d: from בָּנָה ; built up; Binnui, an Israelite.

H1132.d: from בֵּן and זוֹחֵת ; son of Zocheth; Ben- Zocheth, an Israelite.

H1133.d: from בֵּן and חוּר ; son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite.

H1134.d: from בֵּן and חָ֫יִל ; son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite.

H1135.d: from בֵּן and חָנָן ; son of Chanan; Ben- Chanan, an Israelite.

H1136.d: from בֵּן and חָ֫סֶד ; son of kindness; Ben- Chesed, an Israelite.

H1137.d: from בָּנָה ; built; Bani, the name of five Israelites.

H1138.d: or (fuller) Buwniy ; from בָּנָה ; built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite.

H1139.d: from the plural construction of בֵּן and בָּרָק ; sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine.

H1141.d: or (prolonged) Bnayahuw ; from בָּנָה and יָהּ ; Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites.

H1142.d: from the plural of בֵּן and יַעֲקָן ; sons of Yaakan; Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert.

H1143.d: dual of בֵּין ; a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies.

H1144.d: from בֵּן and יָמִין ; son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory.

H1145.d: sometimes (with the article inserted) Ben-ha-yminiy ; with אּישׁ inserted (1 Sam. 9:1) Ben-miysh Ymiyniy ; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened (1 Sam. 9:4; Esth. 2:5) Iysh Ymiyniy ; a man of Jemini, or (1 Sam. 20:1) simply Yminiy ; a Jeminite; (plural Bniy Ymiyniy ; patron from בִּנְיָמִן ; a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin.

H1148.d: probably from בֵּן with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite.

H1149.d: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged.

H1150.d: or Bincah ; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite.

H1151.d: from בֵּן and עָם with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot.

H1152.d: from סוֹד and יָהּ with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite.

H1153.d: from בּוּס ; domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim.

H1154.d: from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape.

H1156.d: (Aramaic) or b ah (Aramaic); corresponding to בָּעָה ; to seek or ask.
H1156.k: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek

H1157.d: from עַד with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H1157.k: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within

H1158.d: a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask.
H1158.k: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out

H1160.d: from בָּעַר (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam.

H1162.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple.

H1163.d: a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise.

H1165.d: from בָּעַר (in the sense of eating): cattle.

H1166.d: a primitive root; to be master; hence, (as denominative from בַּ֫עַל ) to marry.
H1166.k: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, X wife)

H1167.d: from בָּעַל ; a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense).
H1167.k: + archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer, those to whom it is due, + furious, those that are given to it, great, + hairy, he that hath it, have, + horseman, husband, lord, man, + married, master, person, + sworn, they of

H1168.d: the same as בַּ֫עַל ; Baal, a Phoenician deity.

H1170.d: from בַּ֫עַל and בְּרִית ; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites.

H1171.d: from בַּ֫עַל and גָּד ; Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria.

H1173.d: the same as בַּעֲלַת ; Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine.

H1174.d: from בַּ֫עַל and הָמוֹן ; possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine.

H1175.d: plural of בַּעֲלַת ; mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine.
H1175.k: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from `alah with prepositional prefix)

H1176.d: from בַּ֫עַל and זְבוּב ; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites.

H1177.d: from בַּ֫עַל and חָנַן ; possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite.

H1178.d: from בַּ֫עַל and a modification of חָצֵר ; possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine.

H1179.d: from בַּ֫עַל and חֶרְמוֹן ; possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine.

H1180.d: from בַּ֫עַל with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah.

H1181.d: from the plural of בַּ֫עַל and the plural of בָּמָה ; Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan.

H1182.d: from בַּ֫עַל and יָדַע ; Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite.

H1183.d: from בַּ֫עַל and יָהּ ; Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite.

H1184.d: from the plural of בַּ֫עַל and יְהוּדָה ; masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine.

H1185.d: probably from a derivative of עָלַס with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king.

H1186.d: from בַּ֫עַל and מָעוֹן ; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare בֵּית בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן ); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan.

H1187.d: from בַּ֫עַל and פְּעוֹר ; Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity.

H1188.d: from בַּ֫עַל and the plural of פָּ֫רֶץ ; possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine.

H1189.d: from בַּ֫עַל and צָפוֹן (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt.

H1190.d: from בַּ֫עַל and שָׁלִ֫שָׁה ; Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine.

H1191.d: a modification of בַּעֲלַת ; mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine.

H1192.d: from בַּעֲלַת and בְּאֵר ; mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine.

H1193.d: from בַּ֫עַל and תָּמָר ; possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine.

H1194.d: probably a contraction of בֵּית בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן ; Beon, a place East of the Jordan.

H1195.d: the same as בַּעֲנָה ; Banana, the name of four Israelite.

H1196.d: from a derivative of עָנָה with prepositional prefix; in affliction.
H1196.k: Baanah, the name of four Israelites:--Baanah

H1197.d: a primitive root; to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); also (as denominative from בָּ֫עַר ) to be(-come) brutish.
H1197.k: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set ((on fire)), waste

H1198.d: from בָּעַר ; properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid.

H1199.d: from בָּ֫עַר ; brutish: Baara, an Israelitish woman.

H1201.d: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel.

H1202.d: from עָשָׂה and יָהּ with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite.

H1203.d: from עַשְׁתְּרוֹת (as singular of עַשְׁתָּרוֹת ) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan.

H1206.d: probably the same as בּוּץ ; mud (as whitish clay).

H1209.d: perhaps the same as בֵּסָי ; Betsai, the name of two Israelites.

H1210.d: from בָּצַר ; clipped, i.e. the grape crop.

H1211.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion.

H1212.d: probably from צֵל and אֵל with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God; Betsalel, the name of two Israelites.

H1213.d: or Batsliyth ; from the same as בְּצָלִים ; a peeling; Batsluth or Batslith, an Israelite.

H1214.d: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; figuratively, to finish, or (intransitively) stop.
H1214.k: (be) covet(- ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded

H1215.d: from בָּצַע ; plunder; by extension, gain (usually unjust).

H1216.d: a primitive root; perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister.

H1217.d: from בָּצֵק ; dough (as swelling by fermentation).

H1218.d: from בָּצֵק ; a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine.

H1219.d: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from בָּצִיר ) to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification).
H1219.k: cut off, (de-)fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold

H1220.d: from בָּצַר ; strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out).

H1221.d: the same as בָּ֫צֶר , an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite.

H1223.d: feminine from בָּצַר ; an enclosure, i.e. sheep fold.

H1224.d: the same as בָּצְרָה ; Botsrah, a place in Edom.

H1225.d: masculine intensive from בָּצַר ; a fortress.

H1226.d: feminine intensive from בָּצַר ; restraint (of rain), i.e. drought.

H1227.d: the same as בַּקְבֻּק ; Bakbuk, one of the Nethinim.

H1228.d: from בָּקַק ; a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying).

H1229.d: from בַּקְבֻּק and יָהּ ; emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah; Bakbukjah, an Israelite.

H1230.d: reduplicated from בָּקַר ; searcher; Bakbakkar, an Israelite.

H1231.d: from בָּקַק ; wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites.

H1232.d: from בָּקַק and יָהּ ; wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite.

H1234.d: a primitive root; to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open.
H1234.k: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win

H1235.d: from בָּקַע ; a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin).

H1237.d: from בָּקַע ; properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains.

H1238.d: a primitive root; to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine).
H1238.k: (make) empty (out), fail, X utterly, make void

H1239.d: a primitive root; properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider.

H1241.d: from בָּקַר ; beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd.
H1241.k: beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great (cattle), + heifer, herd, kine, ox

H1242.d: from בָּקַר ; properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning.

H1243.d: intensive from בָּקַר ; a looking after.

H1244.d: from בָּקַר ; properly, examination, i.e. (by implication) punishment.

H1245.d: a primitive root; to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after.
H1245.k: ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for)

H1247.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּן ; a son, grandson, etc.

H1248.d: borrowed (as a title) from בַּר ; the heir (apparent to the throne).

H1249.d: from בָּרַר (in its various senses); beloved; also pure, empty.

H1250.d: or bar ; from בָּרַר (in the sense of winnowing); grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extens. the open country.

H1253.d: the same as בֹּר ; vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap for washing, or a flux for metals.

H1254.d: a primitive root; (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes).
H1254.k: choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat)

H1255.d: a variation of NONE ; Berodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king. Birliy.

H1256.d: from בָּרָא and שְׁמוּאֵל ; Jah has created; Berajah, an Israelite.

H1257.d: by reduplication from בָּר ; a fowl (as fattened on grain).

H1260.d: from בָּרַד ; hail; Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite.

H1261.d: from בָּרַד ; spotted (as if with hail).

H1262.d: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from בָּר ) to feed; also (as equivalent to בָּרַר ) to render clear (Eccl. 3:18).

H1263.d: passive participle from בָּרַך ; blessed; Baruk, the name of three Israelites.

H1264.d: probably of foreign origin; damask (stuff of variegated thread).

H1265.d: of uncertain derivation; a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood).

H1266.d: a variation of בְּרוֹשׁ ; the cypress (or some elastic tree).

H1268.d: or Berothay ; probably from בְּרוֹתִים ; cypress or cypresslike; Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine.

H1269.d: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes; Birzoth, an Israelite. ).

H1270.d: perhaps from the root of בִּרְזוּת ; iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement.

H1271.d: from בַּרְזֶל ; iron-hearted; Barzillai, the name of three Israelites.

H1272.d: a primitive root; to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly.
H1272.k: chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot

H1273.d: by transposition for בַּחֲרוּמִי ; a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim.

H1275.d: probably by contraction from בְּאֵרִי ; Beri, an Israelite.

H1276.d: of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine.

H1277.d: from בָּרָא (in the sense of בָּרָה ); fatted or plump.

H1278.d: feminine from בָּרָא ; a creation, i.e. a novelty.

H1281.d: or (shortened) bariach ; from בָּרַח ; a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name.

H1282.d: the same as בָּרִ֫יחַ ; Bariach, an Israelite.

H1283.d: apparently from the feminine of רָע with a prepositional prefix; in trouble; Beriah, the name of four Israelites.

H1284.d: patronymically from בְּרִיעָה ; a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah.

H1285.d: from בָּרָה (in the sense of cutting (like בָּרָא )); a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh).

H1286.d: the same as בְּרִית ; Berith, a Shechemitish deity.

H1288.d: a primitive root; to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason).
H1288.k: X abundantly, X altogether, X at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, X greatly, X indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, X still, thank

H1292.d: from בָּרַך and אֵל , God has blessed; Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends.

H1293.d: from בָּרַך ; benediction; by implication prosperity.

H1294.d: the same as בְּרָכָה ; Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine.

H1295.d: from בָּרַך ; a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting-place).

H1296.d: or Berekyahuw ; from בֶּ֫רֶך and יָהּ ; knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah; Berekjah, the name of six Israelites.

H1297.d: (Aramaic) perhaps from רוּם with a prepositional prefix; properly, highly, i.e. surely; but used adversatively, however.

H1298.d: of uncertain derivation; Bera, a Sodomitish king.

H1300.d: from בָּרַק ; lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword.

H1301.d: the same as בָּרָק ; Barak, an Israelite.

H1302.d: of uncertain derivation; Barkos, one of the Nethimim.

H1303.d: from בָּרָק ; a thorn (perhaps as burning brightly).

H1304.d: or barkath ; from בָּרָק ; a gem (as flashing), perhaps the emerald.

H1305.d: a primitive root; to clarify (i.e. brighten), examine, select.
H1305.k: make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out)

H1306.d: probably from רֶ֫שַׁע with a prepositional prefix; with wickedness; Birsha, a king of Gomorrah.

H1307.d: patrial from בֵּרֹתַי ; a Berothite, or inhabitant of Berothai.

H1308.d: from בָּשַׂר ; cheerful; Besor, a stream of Palestine.

H1309.d: or (shortened) bsorah ; feminine from בָּשַׂר ; glad tidings; by implication, reward for good news.

H1310.d: a primitive root; properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen.
H1310.k: bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden)

H1312.d: of foreign derivation; Bishlam, a Pers.

H1313.d: from an unused root meaning to be fragrant; (compare סַמִּים ) the balsam plant.

H1314.d: or bosem ; from the same as בָּשָׂם ; fragrance; by implication, spicery; also the balsam plant.

H1315.d: feminine of בְּשָׂמִים (the second form); fragrance; Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon.

H1316.d: of uncertain derivation; Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan.

H1318.d: a primitive root; to trample down.

H1319.d: a primitive root; properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news).
H1319.k: messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings

H1320.d: from בָּשַׂר ; flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphem.) the pudenda of a man.
H1320.k: body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-)kind, + nakedness, self, skin

H1322.d: from בּוּשׁ ; shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol.
H1322.k: ashamed, confusion, + greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing)

H1323.d: from בָּנָה (as feminine of בֵּן ); a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively).
H1323.k: apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, X first, X old, + owl, town, village

H1324.d: probably from the same as בַּתּוֹת ; a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids.

H1326.d: probably an orthographical variation for בַּתּוֹת ; desolation.

H1327.d: feminine from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces); desolation.

H1328.d: apparently from the same as בָּתָה and אֵל ; destroyed of God; Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine. Compare בְּתוּל .

H1329.d: for בְּתוּאֵל ; Bethul (i.e. Bethuel), a place in Palestine.

H1330.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate; a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state.

H1331.d: masculine plural of the same as בְּתוּלָה ; (collectively and abstractly) virginity; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it.

H1332.d: from בַּת and יָהּ ; daughter (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Bithjah, an Egyptian woman.

H1333.d: a primitive root; to cut in pieces.

H1334.d: a primitive root, to chop up.

H1336.d: the same as בֶּ֫תֶר ; Bether, a (craggy) place in Palestine.

H1337.d: from בַּת and a masculine plural from רָב ; the daughter (i.e. city) of Rabbah.

H1338.d: from בָּתַר ; (with the article) the craggy spot; Bithron, a place East of the Jordan.

H1339.d: from בַּת and שֶׁ֫בַע (in the sense of שָׁבַע ); daughter of an oath; Bath-Sheba, the mother of Solomon.

H1340.d: from בַּת and שׁ֫וֹעַ ; daughter of wealth; Bath-shua, the same as בַּת־שֶׁ֫בַע.

H1342.d: a primitive root; to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic.
H1342.k: gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph

H1345.d: from גָּאָה and אֵל ; majesty of God; Geuel, an Israelite.

H1346.d: from גָּאָה ; arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament.
H1346.k: excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling

H1347.d: from גָּאָה ; the same as גַּאֲוָה.
H1347.k: arrogancy, excellency(-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling

H1348.d: from גָּאָה ; the same as גַּאֲוָה.
H1348.k: excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging

H1350.d: a primitive root, to redeem (according to the Oriental law of kinship), i.e. to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.).
H1350.k: X in any wise, X at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger

H1351.d: a primitive root, (rather identified with גָּאַל , through the idea of freeing, i.e. repudiating); to soil or (figuratively) desecrate.

H1353.d: feminine passive participle of גָּאַל ; redemption (including the right and the object); by implication, relationship.

H1354.d: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; the back (as rounded (compare גֵּו and גּוּף ); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.
H1354.k: back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, (eye)brows, nave, ring

H1356.d: from גּוּב ; a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug).

H1357.d: probably from גּוּב (compare גֹּבַי ); a locust (from its cutting).

H1358.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to גּוּב ; a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out).

H1359.d: or (fully) Gowb ; from גּוּב ; pit; Gob, a place in Palestine.

H1360.d: from an unused root meaning probably to collect; a reservoir; by analogy, a marsh.

H1361.d: a primitive root; to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty.
H1361.k: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward

H1363.k: excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride

H1364.d: or (fully) gabowahh ; from גָּבַהּ ; elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant.
H1364.k: haughty, height, high(-er), lofty, proud, X exceeding proudly

H1366.d: or (shortened) gbul ; from גָּבַל ; properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extens. the territory inclosed.
H1366.k: border, bound, coast, X great, landmark, limit, quarter, space

H1367.d: or (shortened) gbulah ; feminine of גְּבוּל ; a boundary, region. place.

H1368.d: or (shortened) gibbor ; intensive from the same as גָּ֫בֶר ; powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant.
H1368.k: champion, chief, X excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man

H1369.d: feminine passive participle from the same as גִּבּוֹר ; force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory.
H1369.k: force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength

H1371.d: from an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead); bald in the forehead.

H1383.d: from גָּבַל ; a twisted chain or lace.

H1390.d: the same as גִּבְעָה ; Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine.

H1393.d: patrial from גִּבְעוֹן ; a Gibonite, or inhabitant of Gibon.

H1417.d: or (feminine) gdudah ; from גָּדַד ; a furrow (as cut).

H1419.d: or (shortened) gadol ; from גָּדַל ; great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent.

H1430.d: from an unused root (meaning to heap up); a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb.

H1434.d: from גָּדַל (in the sense of twisting); thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon.

H1453.d: dual of גְּדֵרָה ; double wall; Gederothajim, a place in Palestine.

H1455.d: a primitive root; to remove (a bandage from a wound, i.e. heal it).

H1457.d: a primitive root; to prostrate oneself.

H1460.d: from גָּאָה (corresponding to גָּב ); the back; by analogy, the middle.

H1463.d: of uncertain derivation; Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some nothern nation.

H1464.d: a primitive root (akin to גָּדַד ); to crowd upon, i.e. attack.

H1465.d: feminine of גֵּו ; the back, i.e. (by extensive) the person.

H1466.d: the same as גֵּוָה ; exaltation; (figuratively) arrogance.

H1468.d: a primitive root (compare גָּזַז ); properly, to shear off; but used only in the (figuratively) sense of passing rapidly.

H1474.d: from גּוֹלָה ; captive; Golan, a place east of the Jordan.

H1476.d: probably from גָּנַן ; protected; Guni, the name of two Israelites.

H1477.d: patronymically from גּוּנִי ; a Gunite (collectively with article prefix) or descendants of Guni.

H1484.d: or (feminine) gorah ; a variation of גּוּר.

H1488.d: from גָּזַז ; a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass.

H1491.d: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז ); to cut off, i.e. portion out.

H1493.d: patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine; a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh.

H1494.d: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז ); to cut off; specifically to shear a flock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy.

H1495.d: from גָּזַז ; shearer; Gazez, the name of two Israelites.

H1496.d: from גָּזָה ; something cut, i.e. dressed stone.

H1497.d: a primitive root; to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob.

H1501.d: from an unused root meaning to devour; a kind of locust.

H1502.d: from the same as גָּזָם ; devourer.

H1503.d: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees); the trunk or stump of a tree (as felled or as planted).

H1506.d: from גָּזַר ; something cut off; a portion.

H1526.d: patrial from גִּלֹה ; a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh.

H1527.d: of uncertain derivation; Ginath, an Israelite.

H1529.d: from the same as גִּישׁ ; lumpish; Geshan, an Israelite.

H1548.d: a primitive root; properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste.

H1549.d: or gilyown ; from גָּלָה ; a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate).

H1555.d: perhaps from גָּלָה ; exile; Goljath, a Philistine.

H1562.d: from גֵּ֫לֶל ; dungy; Gilalai, an Israelite.

H1566.d: a primitive root; to be obstinate.

H1574.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp; properly, a span.

H1575.d: from the same as גֹּ֫מֶד ; a warrior (as grasping weapons).

H1576.d: from גָּמַל ; treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital.

H1578.d: feminine of גְּמוּל ; meaning the same.

H1579.d: of uncertain derivation; Gimzo, a place in Palestine.

H1580.d: a primitive root; to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean.

H1589.d: a primitive root; to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive.

H1591.d: from גָּנַב ; stealing, i.e. (concretely) something stolen.

H1592.d: from גָּנַב ; theft; Genubath, an Edomitish prince.

H1595.d: from an unused root meaning to store; treasure; by implication, a coffer.

H1598.d: a primitive root; to hedge about, i.e. (generally) protect.

H1599.d: or Ginnthow ; from גָּנַן ; gardener; Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite.

H1600.d: a primitive root; to bellow (as cattle).

H1601.d: feminine active participle of גָּעָה ; lowing; Goah, a place near Jerusalem.

H1602.d: a primitive root; to detest; by implication, to reject.

H1603.d: from גָּעַל ; loathing; Gaal, an Israelite.

H1609.d: of uncertain derivation; Gatam, an Edomite.

H1610.d: from an unused root meaning to arch; the back; by extensive the body or self.

H1612.d: from an unused root meaning to bend; a vine (as twining), especially the grape.

H1613.d: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in; a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress.
