H3425.d: from יָרַשׁ ; something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony.

H3426.d: perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb ( הָיָה ); there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection).
H3426.k: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest

H3427.d: a primitive root; properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry.
H3427.k: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, X fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, X marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(- tle), (down-)sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry

H3428.d: from יָשַׁב and אָב ; seat of (his) father; Jeshebab, an Israelite.

H3429.d: from the active participle of יָשַׁב and שָׁ֫בֶת , with a preposition and the article interposed; sitting in the seat; Josheb-bash-Shebeth, an Israelite.

H3430.d: from יָשַׁב and נֹב , with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob; Jishbo-be-Nob, a Philistine.

H3431.d: from שָׁבַח ; he will praise; Jishbach, an Israelite.

H3432.d: patronymically from יָשׁוּב ; a Jashubite, or descendant of Jashub.

H3433.d: from שׁוּב and לָ֫חֶם ; returner of bread; Jashubi-Lechem, an Israelite. (Prob. the text should be pointed Yoshbev Lechem , and rendered "(they were) inhabitants of Lechem," i.e. of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare לַחְמִי ).

H3434.d: from שׁוּב and עָם ; people will return; Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites.

H3435.d: from an unused root corresponding to שְׁבַק ; he will leave; Jishbak, a son of Abraham.

H3436.d: from יָשַׁב and קָשֶׁה ; a hard seat; Joshbekashah, an Israelite.

H3437.d: or Yashiyb ; from שׁוּב ; he will return; Jashub, the name of two Israelites.

H3438.d: from שָׁוָה ; he will level; Jishvah, an Israelite: -Ishvah, Isvah.

H3439.d: from the same as יֶ֫שַׁח and יָהּ ; Jah will empty; Jeshochajah, an Israelite.

H3440.d: from שָׁוָה ; level; Jishvi, the name of two Israelites.

H3441.d: patronymically from יִשְׁוִי ; a Jishvite (collectively) or descendants of Jishvi.

H3442.d: for יְהוֹשׁ֫וּעַ ; he will save; Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine.

H3444.d: feminine passive participle of יָשַׁע ; something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity.
H3444.k: deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare

H3445.d: from an unused root meaning to gape (as the empty stomach); hunger.

H3446.d: from שַׁחֲצוֹם ; he will laugh; Jischak, the heir of Abraham. Compare יִצְחָק .

H3448.d: by Aramaic Iyshay ; from the same as יֵשׁ ; extant; Jishai, David's father.

H3449.d: or Yishshiyahuw ; from נָשָׁה and יָהּ ; Jah will lend; Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites.

H3450.d: from שׂוּם and אֵל ; God will place; Jesimael, an Israelite.

H3454.d: from יָשִׁישׁ ; aged; Jeshishai, an Israelite.

H3455.d: a prim root; to place; intransitively, to be placed.

H3456.d: a primitive root; to lie waste.

H3457.d: from יָשַׁם ; desolate; Jishma, an Israelite: -Ishma.

H3458.d: from שָׁמַע and אֵל ; God will hear; Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites.

H3459.d: patronymically from יִשְׁמָעֵאל ; a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael.

H3460.d: or Yishmacyahuw ; from שָׁמַע and יָהּ ; Jah will hear; Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites.

H3461.d: from שָׁמַר ; preservative; Jishmerai, an Israelite.

H3462.d: a primitive root; properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate: -old (store), remain long, (make to) sleep.

H3464.d: the same as יָשֵׁן ; Jashen, an Israelite.

H3466.d: feminine of יָשָׁן ; Jeshanah, a place in Palestine.

H3467.d: a primitive root; properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor.
H3467.k: X at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory

H3468.d: or yeshai ; from יָשַׁע ; liberty, deliverance, prosperity.

H3469.d: from יָשַׁע ; saving; Jishi, the name of four Israelites.

H3470.d: or Yshayahuw ; from יָשַׁע and יָהּ ; Jah has saved; Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites.

H3471.d: from an unused root meaning to polish; a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name).

H3472.d: perhaps from שָׁפָה ; he will scratch; Jishpah, an Israelite.

H3473.d: probably from the same as שָׁפָן ; he will hide; Jishpan, an Israelite.

H3474.d: a primitive root; to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous.
H3474.k: direct, fit, seem good (meet), + please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly)

H3475.d: from יָשַׁר ; the right; Jesher, an Israelite: -Jesher.

H3477.k: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), + pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness)

H3478.d: from שָׂרָה and אֵל ; he will rule as God; Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity.

H3480.d: by variation from יָשָׁר and אֵל with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesarelah, an Israelite.

H3481.d: patronymically from יִשְׂרָאֵל ; a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael.

H3482.d: feminine of יִשְׂרְאֵלִי ; a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael.

H3484.d: from יָשַׁר ; upright; Jeshurun, a symbol. name for Israel.

H3485.d: (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from נָשָׂא and שָׂכָר ; he will bring a reward; Jissaskar, a son of Jacob.

H3486.d: from an unused root meaning to blanch; gray-haired, i.e. an aged man.

H3487.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אוֹת ; a sign of the object of a verb: + whom.

H3488.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָשַׁב ; to sit or dwell: -dwell, (be) set, sit.

H3489.d: from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; a peg.

H3490.d: from an unused root meaning to be lonely; a bereaved person.

H3491.d: passive participle of יָתַר ; properly, what is left, i.e. (by implication) a gleaning.

H3492.d: from יָתַר ; redundant; Jattir, a place in Palestine.

H3493.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to יַתִּיר ; preeminent; as an adverb, very.

H3494.d: probably from תָּלָה ; it will hang, i.e. be high; Jithlah, a place in Palestine.

H3495.d: from the same as יָתוֹם ; orphanage; Jithmah, an Israelite.

H3496.d: from an unused root meaning to endure, and אֵל ; continued of God; Jathniel, an Israelite.

H3497.d: from the same as תַּנִּין ; extensive; Jithnan, a place in Palestine.

H3498.d: a primitive root; to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve.
H3498.k: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, - nant), reserve, residue, rest

H3499.d: from יָתַר ; properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free).
H3499.k: + abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with

H3500.d: the same as יֶ֫תֶר ; Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite. Compare יִתְרוֹ .

H3501.d: by variation for יִתְרָה ; Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite).

H3502.d: feminine of יֶ֫תֶר ; properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth.

H3503.d: from יֶ֫תֶר with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law. Compare יֶ֫תֶר .

H3505.d: patronymically from יֶ֫תֶר ; a Jithrite or descendant of Jether.

H3506.d: from יָתַר ; excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite.

H3507.d: from יֶ֫תֶר and עָם ; excellence of people; Jithream, a son of David.

H3508.d: feminine active participle of יָתַר ; the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging).

H3509.d: of uncertain derivation; Jetheth, an Edomite: -Jetheth.

H3510.d: a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil.
H3510.k: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful

H3511.d: from כָּאַב ; suffering (physical or mental), adversity.

H3512.d: a primitive root; to despond: causatively, to deject.

H3513.d: or kabed ; a primitive root; to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses).
H3513.k: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, X be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, X more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop

H3514.d: from כָּבַד ; weight, multitude, vehemence: -grievousness, heavy, great number.

H3515.d: from כָּבַד ; heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid).
H3515.k: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick

H3516.d: the same as כָּבֵד ; the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera).

H3518.d: a primitive root; to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger).

H3519.d: rarely kabod ; from כָּבַד ; properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness.

H3520.d: irreg. feminine passive participle of כָּבַד ; weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth.

H3521.d: from the same as כֶּ֫בֶל in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine.

H3522.d: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabon, a place in Palestine.

H3523.d: from כָּבַר in the original sense of plaiting; a matrass (of intertwined materials).

H3524.d: from כָּבַר ; vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many.
H3524.k: + feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant

H3525.d: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; a fetter.

H3526.d: a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative.

H3527.d: a primitive root; properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate).

H3528.d: from כָּבַר ; properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto.

H3529.d: the same as כְּבָר ; length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia. Compare חָבוֹר .

H3530.d: feminine of כְּבָר ; properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension).

H3531.d: from כָּבַר in its original sense; a sieve (as netted).

H3532.d: from an unused root meaning to dominate; a ram (just old enough to butt).

H3533.d: a primitive root; to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate.
H3533.k: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection

H3534.d: from כָּבַשׁ ; a footstool (as trodden upon): -footstool.

H3535.d: or kabsah ; feminine of כֶּ֫בֶשׂ ; a ewe.

H3536.d: from כָּבַשׁ ; a smelting furnace (as reducing metals).

H3537.d: from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes.

H3538.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to כָּזַב ; false: -lying.

H3539.d: from the same as כַּד in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; a sparkling gem, probably the ruby.

H3540.d: of foreign origin; Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king.

H3541.d: from the prefix k and הוּא ; properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now.
H3541.k: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder

H3543.d: a primitive root; to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull.
H3543.k: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, X utterly

H3544.k: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking

H3545.d: feminine of כֵּהָה ; properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure.

H3546.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to יָכֹל and כּוּל ; to be able.

H3547.d: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from כֹּהֵן ; to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia.
H3547.k: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office)

H3548.d: active participle of כָּהַן ; literally, one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman).
H3548.k: chief ruler, X own, priest, prince, principal officer

H3551.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to לַ֫הַג in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation).

H3552.d: of foreign derivation; Kub, a country near Egypt.

H3553.d: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched). Compare קוֹבַע .

H3554.d: a primitive root; properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into).

H3556.d: probably from the same as כַּבּוֹן (in the sense of rolling) or כָּוָה (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince.

H3557.d: a primitive root; properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses).
H3557.k: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals)

H3558.d: from an unused root meaning to store away; a jewel (probably gold beads).

H3559.d: a primitive root; properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous).
H3559.k: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-)stablish, stand, tarry, X very deed

H3560.d: probably from כּוּן ; established; Kun, a place in Syria.

H3561.d: from כּוּן ; something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer.

H3562.d: from כּוּן and יָהּ ; Jah has sustained; Conanjah, the name of two Israelites. Compare כְּנַנְיָה .

H3563.d: from an unused root meaning to hold together; a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye). Compare כִּיס .

H3564.d: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated). Compare כִּירַ֫יִם .

H3565.d: from כּוּר and עָשָׁן ; furnace of smoke; Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine.

H3566.d: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) Koresh ; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king.

H3568.d: probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite.

H3569.d: patronymically from כּוּשׁ ; a Cushite, or descendant of Cush.

H3570.d: the same as כּוּשִׁי ; Cushi, the name of two Israelites.

H3571.d: feminine of כּוּשִׁי ; a Cushite woman: -Ethiopian.

H3572.d: perhaps from כּוּשׁ ; Cushan, a region of Arabia: -Cushan.

H3573.d: apparently from כּוּשָׁן and the dual of רִשְׁעָה ; Cushan of double wickedness; Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king.

H3574.d: from כָּשֵׁר ; prosperity; in plural freedom: -X chain.

H3575.d: or (feminine) Kuwthah ; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria.

H3576.d: a primitive root; to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively.
H3576.k: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain

H3577.d: from כָּזַב ; falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol).
H3577.k: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying

H3578.d: from כָּזַב ; fallacious; Cozeba, a place in Palestine.

H3579.d: from כָּזַב ; false; Cozbi, a Midianitess.

H3580.d: from כָּזַב ; falsified; Kezib, a place in Palestine.

H3581.d: or (Dan. 11:6) kowach ; from an unused root meaning to be firm; vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard: -ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.

H3582.d: a primitive root; to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy.

H3583.d: a primitive root; to paint (with stibium): -paint.

H3584.d: a primitive root; to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe).
H3584.k: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-)lie, lying, submit selves

H3585.d: from כָּחַשׁ ; literally, a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy.

H3587.d: from כָּוָה ; a brand or scar.

H3588.d: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed.
H3588.k: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-)as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-)though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet

H3589.d: from a primitive root meaning to strike: a crushing; figuratively, calamity.

H3590.d: from the same as כִּיד (compare כַּדְכֹּד ); properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck).

H3591.d: from the same as כִּיד ; properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart (perhaps smaller that חֲנִית ).

H3592.d: the same as כִּידוֹן ; Kidon, a place in Palestine: -Chidon.

H3594.d: from כּוּן ; properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) for some heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor).

H3595.d: or kiyor ; from the same as כּוּר ; properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform.

H3596.d: or kelay ; from כּוּל in the sense of withholding; niggardly.

H3597.d: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer.

H3598.d: from the same as כּוּמָז ; a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades.

H3599.d: a form for כּוֹס ; a cup; also a bag for money or weights.

H3600.d: a form for כּוּר (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set): -ranges for pots.

H3601.d: from כָּשֵׁר ; literally, a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of a distaff ( פֶּ֫לֶך ), by which it is twirled.

H3602.d: from כֹּה ; just so, referring to the previous or following context.
H3602.k: after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus

H3603.d: from כָּרַר ; a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, expec. the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large (round) coin).

H3605.d: or (Jer. 33:8) kowl ; from כָּלַל ; properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense).
H3605.k: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-)thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever)

H3606.k: all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where)-fore, + though, what (where, who)-soever, (the) whole

H3607.d: a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit).
H3607.k: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold

H3608.d: from כָּלָא ; a prison. Compare כִּלְאָ֫יִם , כְּלִיא .

H3609.d: apparently from כָּלָא and אָב ; restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite.

H3610.d: dual of כֶּ֫לֶא in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities.

H3611.d: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute.

H3612.d: perhaps a form of כָּ֫לֶב , or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites.

H3613.d: from כָּלֵב and אֶפְרָת ; Caleb- Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct).

H3614.d: probably by erroneous transcription for Kalebiy ; patronymically from כָּלֵב ; a Calebite or descendant of Caleb.

H3615.d: a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume).. were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, X fully, X have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.
H3615.k: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when

H3617.d: from כָּלָה ; a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction.
H3617.k: altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance

H3618.d: from כָּלַל ; a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife.

H3619.d: from the same as כָּ֫לֶב ; a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage).

H3620.d: the same as כְּלוּב ; Kelub, the name of two Israelites.

H3621.d: a form of כָּלֵב ; Kelubai, an Israelite: -Chelubai.

H3622.d: from כָּלָה ; completed; Keluhai, an Israelite.

H3623.d: denominative passive participle from כַּלָּה ; bridehood (only in the plural).

H3624.d: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity.

H3625.d: the same as כָּ֫לַח ; Kelach, a place in Assyria: -Calah.

H3626.d: from כֹּל and חֹזֶה ; every seer; Col- Chozeh, an Israelite.

H3627.d: from כָּלָה ; something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon).
H3627.k: armour ((-bearer)), artillery, bag, carriage, + furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, X one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, + psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, + whatsoever

H3628.d: or kluw1 ; from כָּלָא (compare כֶּ֫לֶא ); a prison.

H3629.d: feminine of כְּלִי (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self).

H3630.d: a form of כִּלָּיוֹן ; Kiljon, an Israelite.

H3632.d: from כָּלַל ; complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully.
H3632.k: all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly

H3633.d: from כּוּל ; sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite.

H3636.d: from כָּלַל ; complete; Kelal, an Israelite.

H3637.d: a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult.
H3637.k: be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame

H3638.d: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire.

H3641.d: or Kalneh ; also Kalnow ; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire. Compare כַּנֵּה .

H3642.d: a primitive root; to pine after.

H3643.d: from כָּמַהּ ; pining; Kimham, an Israelite.

H3644.d: or kamow ; a form of the prefix "k-", but used separately (compare כֵּן ); as, thus, so.
H3644.k: according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth

H3645.d: or (Jer. 48:7) Kmiysh ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites.

H3646.d: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; "cummin" (from its use as a condiment).

H3647.d: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory.

H3648.d: a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity).

H3649.d: from כָּמַר ; properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural).

H3650.d: redupl. from כָּמַר ; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural).

H3651.d: from כּוּן ; properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles).. as, + (for-)asmuch as yet, + be (for which) cause, + following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), X the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, + there (where)-fore, this, thus, true, well, X you.

H3653.d: the same as כֵּן , used as a noun; a stand, i.e. pedestal or station.
H3653.k: base, estate, foot, office, place, well

H3654.d: from כָּנַן in the sense of fastening; a gnat (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irreg. in Exod. 8:17,18; Heb. 13:14)).

H3655.d: a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize.

H3656.d: for כַּלְנוֹ ; Canneh, a place in Assyria.

H3658.d: from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp: -harp.

H3659.d: for יְכָנְיָה ; Conjah, an Israelite king.

H3660.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to NONE ; so or thus.

H3661.d: a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant.

H3662.d: from כָּנַן ; planted; Kenani, an Israelite: -Chenani.

H3663.d: or Knanyahuw ; from כָּנַן and יָהּ ; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite.

H3664.d: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold: -gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish.
H3665.k: bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue

H3666.d: from כָּנַע in the sense of folding (compare כָּנַס ); a package.

H3667.d: from כָּנַע ; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him.

H3668.d: feminine of כְּנַ֫עַן ; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites.

H3669.d: patrial from כְּנַ֫עַן ; a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans).

H3670.d: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw.

H3671.d: from כָּנַף ; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bed-clothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle.
H3671.k: + bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), X flying, + (one an-)other, overspreading, X quarters, skirt, X sort, uttermost part, wing((-ed))

H3672.d: or Kinnereth ; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as כִּנּוֹר ; perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine.

H3674.d: from כָּנָה ; a colleague (as having the same title).

H3676.d: apparently a contraction for כִּסֵּא , but probably by erroneous transcription for נֵס.

H3677.d: or keceh ; apparently from כָּסָה ; properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival.

H3678.d: or kicceh ; from כָּסָה ; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied).

H3680.d: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy). Compare כָּשָׂה .
H3680.k: clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm

H3681.d: passive participle of כָּסָה ; properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering.

H3682.d: from כָּסָה ; a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling.

H3683.d: a primitive root; to cut off.

H3684.d: from כָּסַל ; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly.

H3685.d: the same as כְּסִיל ; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one).

H3686.d: the same as כְּסִיל ; Kesil, a place in Palestine: -Chesil.

H3688.d: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly.

H3689.d: from כָּסַל ; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust.

H3690.d: feminine of כָּ֫סֶל ; in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness.

H3691.d: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Heb. month.

H3692.d: from כָּסַל ; hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite.

H3693.d: from כָּסַל ; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine.

H3694.d: feminine plural of passive participle of כָּסַל ; fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine.

H3695.d: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians.

H3696.d: from the feminine plural of כָּ֫סֶל and תָּבוֹר ; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine.

H3697.d: a primitive root; to shear. Compare יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה .

H3698.d: from כָּסַם ; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn).

H3700.d: a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear.

H3701.d: from כָּסַף ; silver (from its pale color); by implication, money.

H3703.d: perhaps from כָּ֫סֶפ ; silvery; Casiphja, a place in Bab.

H3704.d: from כָּסָה ; a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed).

H3706.d: (Aramaic) or kaeth (Aramaic); feminine of כְּעַן ; thus (only in the formula "and so forth").

H3707.d: a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant.
H3707.k: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth

H3708.d: or (in Job) kaoas ; from כָּעַס ; vexation: -anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, X sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.d: from כָּפַף ; the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power.
H3709.k: branch, + foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon

H3711.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue.

H3712.d: feminine of כָּף ; a leaf of a palm-tree.

H3713.d: from כָּפַר ; properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground).

H3714.d: from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder.

H3715.d: from כָּפַר ; a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane). Compare כְּפַר .

H3716.d: feminine of כְּפִיר ; the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine.

H3717.d: a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat.

H3720.d: from כָּפַן ; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain).

H3722.d: a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel.
H3722.k: appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation)

H3723.d: from כָּפַר ; a village (as protected by walls): -village. Compare כְּפִיר .

H3724.d: from כָּפַר ; properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price.
H3724.k: bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village

H3726.d: from כְּפַר and עַמּוֹנִי , with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine.

H3727.d: from כָּפַר ; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark).

H3728.d: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate.

H3729.d: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter.

H3730.d: or (Am. 9:1) kaphtowr ; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of a column, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum: knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.d: or (Am. 9:7) Kaphtowr ; apparently the same as כַּפְתֹּר ; Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines.

H3732.d: patrial from כַּפְתּוֹר ; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor.

H3733.d: from כָּרַר in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out). See also בֵּית כָּר , כָּרִים .

H3734.d: from the same as כּוּר ; properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry. Aramaic the same.

H3735.d: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to כָּרָה in the sense of piercing (figuratively); to grieve.

H3736.d: from the same as כֶּ֫בֶל ; to gird or clothe: -clothed.

H3737.d: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of מְכֻרְבָּל ; a mantle.

H3738.d: a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open.

H3739.d: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of כָּרָה (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase.

H3742.d: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure.

H3743.d: the same as כְּרוּב ; Kerub, a place in Bab.: -Cherub.

H3745.d: (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim.

H3746.d: perhaps an abridged plural of כָּר in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman.

H3747.d: from כָּרַת ; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine: -Cherith.

H3748.d: from כָּרַת ; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce.

H3749.d: expanded from the same as כַּבּוֹן ; a rim or top margin.

H3750.d: probably of foreign origin; the crocus.

H3751.d: of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria.

H3752.d: of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes: -Carcas.

H3753.d: from כָּרַר ; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing).

H3754.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard. See also בֵּית הַכָּ֫רֶם .

H3755.d: active participle of an imaginary denominative from כָּ֫רֶם ; a vinedresser.
H3755.k: vine dresser (as one or two words)

H3756.d: from כָּ֫רֶם ; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites.

H3757.d: patronymically from כַּרְמִי ; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi.

H3758.d: probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red: -crimson.

H3759.d: from כָּ֫רֶם ; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce.
H3759.k: full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field)

H3760.d: the same as כַּרְמֶל ; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine.

H3761.d: patron from כַּרְמֶל ; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town).

H3762.d: feminine of כַּרְמְלִי ; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel.

H3763.d: of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean.

H3766.d: a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate.
H3766.k: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, X very

H3767.d: from כָּרַע ; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual).

H3768.d: of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool: -green.

H3769.d: a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl): -dance(-ing).

H3770.d: by variation from קָרַס ; the paunch or belly (as swelling out).

H3771.d: of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes.

H3772.d: a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces).
H3772.k: be chewed, be con-(feder-)ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league ((covenant)), X lose, perish, X utterly, X want

H3773.d: passive participle feminine of כָּרַת ; something cut, i.e. a hewn timber.

H3774.d: probably from כָּרַת in the sense of executioner; a Kerethite or life-guardsman (compare טַבָּח ) (only collectively in the singular as plural).

H3775.d: apparently by transposition for כֶּ֫בֶשׂ ; a young sheep.

H3776.d: feminine of כֶּ֫שֶׂב ; a young ewe.

H3777.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham.

H3778.d: or (occasionally with enclitic) Kasdiymah ; towards the Kasdites.
H3778.k: into Chaldea), patronymically from Kesed (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people:--Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea

H3779.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כַּשְׂדִּי ; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer.

H3780.d: a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh). Compare כָּסָה .

H3781.d: from כָּשַׁל ; properly, a feller, i.e. an axe: -ax.

H3782.d: a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall.
H3782.k: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, X utterly, be weak

H3783.d: from כָּשַׁל ; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin.

H3784.d: a primitive root; properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic.

H3787.d: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper.

H3789.d: a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe).

H3791.d: from כָּתַב ; something written, i.e. a writing, record or book.

H3793.d: from כָּתַב ; a letter or other mark branded on the skin.

H3794.d: or Kittiyiy ; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine.

H3796.d: from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates).

H3798.d: from כֹּ֫תֶל and אּישׁ ; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine.

H3799.d: a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly.

H3800.d: from כָּתַם ; properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined).

H3801.d: or kuttoneth ; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare כָּתֵף ); a shirt.

H3802.d: from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything.

H3803.d: a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself).
H3803.k: beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer

H3804.d: from כָּתַר ; properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem: -crown.

H3805.d: feminine active participle of כָּתַר ; the capital of a column.

H3806.d: a primitive root; to butt or pound.

H3807.d: a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike.
H3807.k: beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp

H3808.d: or lowi ; or loh (Deut. 3:11); a primitive particle; not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles (as follows)..,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, + surely, + as truly as, + of a truth, + verily, for want, + whether, without.
H3808.k: X before, + or else, ere, + except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), (X as though

H3809.k: or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), ((can-))not, as nothing, without

H3810.d: or Low Dbar (2 Samuel 9:4,5); or Lidbir (Joshua 13:26); (probably rather Lodbar ); from לֹא and דֹּ֫בֶר ; pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine.

H3811.d: a primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted.

H3812.d: from לָאָה ; weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob.

H3814.d: from לָאַט (or perhaps for active participle of לוּט ); properly, muffled, i.e. silently.

H3815.d: from the prepositional prefix and אֵל ; (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite.

H3816.d: or l owm ; from an unused root meaning to gather; a community.

H3817.d: plural of לְאֹם ; communities; Leum mim, an Arabian.

H3818.d: from לֹא and עָם with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea.

H3819.d: from לֹא and רָחַם ; not pitied; Lo- Ruchamah, the symbol. name of a son of Hosea.

H3820.d: a form of לֵבָב ; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything.
H3820.k: + care for, comfortably, consent, X considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart((-ed)), X heed, X I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), X regard((-ed)), X themselves, X unawares, understanding, X well, willingly, wisdom

H3822.d: plural of לָבִיא ; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine. See also בֵּית לְבָאוֹת .

H3823.d: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from לֵבָב ) to unheart, i.e. (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; also (as denominative from לְבִבוֹת ) to make cakes.

H3824.d: from לָבַב ; the heart (as the most interior organ); used also like לֵב.
H3824.k: + bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-)heart((-ed)), midst, mind, X unawares, understanding

H3828.d: or lbonah ; from לָבָן ; frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke): -(frank-)incense.

H3829.d: the same as לְבוֹנָה ; Lebonah, a place in Palestine.

H3830.d: or lbush ; from לָבַשׁ ; a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphem.) a wife.
H3830.k: apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture

H3832.d: a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall.

H3833.d: or (Ezek. 19:2) lbiyao ; irreg. masculine plural lbaviym ; irreg. feminine plural lbaeowth ; from an unused root men. to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer; compare אֲרִי )).

H3834.d: or rather lbibah ; from לָבַב in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned).

H3835.d: a primitive root; to be (or become) white; also (as denominative from לְבֵנִים ) to make bricks.

H3837.d: the same as לָבָן ; Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert.

H3838.d: or Lbanah ; the same as לְבָנָה ; Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim.

H3839.d: from לָבַן ; some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax.

H3840.d: from לָבַן ; properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency.

H3841.d: the same as לִבְנֶה ; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine.

H3842.d: from לָבַן ; properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon. See also לְבָנָה .

H3843.d: from לָבַן ; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay).

H3844.d: from לְבַב ; (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine.

H3845.d: from לָבַן ; white; Libni, an Israelite.

H3846.d: patronymically from לִבְנִי ; a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively).

H3847.d: or labesh ; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on a garment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively.
H3847.k: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear

H3849.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like כַּד ); a log or measure for liquids.

H3850.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine.

H3851.d: from an usused root meaning to gleam; a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon.

H3852.d: or lahebeth ; feminine of לַ֫הַב , and meaning the same.

H3853.d: plural of לַ֫הַב ; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizrain, and his descendants.

H3854.d: from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application.

H3855.d: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare לַ֫הַב ) or else to be earnest (compare לַ֫הַג ); Lahad, an Israelite.

H3856.d: a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication) to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish.

H3857.d: a primitive root; properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze.
H3857.k: burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle

H3858.d: from לָהַט ; a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert).

H3859.d: a primitive root; properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle.

H3860.d: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and הֵן ; popularly for if; hence, therefore.
H3860.k: for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix)

H3861.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לָהֵן ; therefore; also except.

H3862.d: probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly.

H3863.d: or lu ; or luw ; a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!.
H3863.k: if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that)

H3864.d: or Lubbiy (Dan. 11:43); partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural): -Lubim(-s), Libyans.

H3865.d: probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations.

H3866.d: or Luwdiyiy ; patrial from לוּד ; a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural). Lydians.

H3867.d: a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend.
H3867.k: abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er)

H3868.d: a primitive root; to turn aside (compare לָוָה , לוּט and לוּן ), i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse.

H3869.d: probably of foreign origin; some kind of nut-tree, perhaps the almond.

H3870.d: probably from לוּז (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine.

H3871.d: or luach ; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal.

H3872.d: or Luchowth (Jer. 48:5); from the same as ל֫וּחַ ; floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan.

H3873.d: active participle of לָחַשׁ ; (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite. the article).

H3874.d: a primitive root; to wrap up.

H3876.d: the same as לוֹט ; Lot, Abraham's nephew.

H3877.d: from לוֹט ; covering; Lotan, an Idumaean: -Lotan.

H3878.d: from לָוָה ; attached; Levi, a son of Jacob. See also לֵוָיֵא , לֵוִי .

H3880.d: from לָוָה ; something attached, i.e. a wreath: -ornament.

H3881.d: or Leviy ; patronymically from לֵוִי ; a Levite or descendant of Levi.

H3882.d: from לָוָה ; a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea- monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Bab.

H3883.d: from an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step. Compare לֻלָאֹת .

H3884.d: or luwley ; from לוּא and לֹא ; if not..not), unless, were it not that.

H3885.d: or liyn ; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain).
H3885.k: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night)

H3886.d: a primitive root; to gulp; figuratively, to be rash.

H3887.d: a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede.
H3887.k: ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher

H3889.d: from לוּשׁ ; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine. Compare לַ֫יִשׁ .

H3890.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to לָוָה ; properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with.

H3892.d: from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried.

H3893.d: from the same as לָח ; freshness, i.e. vigor: -natural force.

H3894.d: or lachum ; passive participle of לָחַם ; properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body..is eating, flesh.

H3895.d: from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone.

H3896.d: a form of לֶ֫חִי ; Lechi, a place in Palestine. Compare also רָ֫מַת לֶ֫חִי .

H3898.d: a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction).
H3898.k: devour, eat, X ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring)

H3899.d: from לָחַם ; food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it). See also בֵּית לְעַפְרָה .
H3899.k: ((shew-))bread, X eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals

H3902.d: from לָ֫חֶם ; foodful; Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי. See also יָשֻׁ֫בִילָ֫חֶם .

H3903.d: probably by erroneous transcription for Lachmam ; from לָ֫חֶם ; food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine.

H3904.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine.

H3905.d: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress.
H3905.k: afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self

H3907.d: a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble a spell (as a magician).

H3908.d: from לָחַשׁ ; properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet.

H3909.d: a form of לָאט or else participle from לוּט ; properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly: -enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3910.d: probably from לוּט ; a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum.

H3911.d: from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits).

H3912.d: masculine plural of passive participle of לָטַשׁ ; hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe.

H3913.d: a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen.

H3914.d: a form of לִוְיַת ; a wreath.

H3915.d: or (Isa. 21:11) leyl ; also laylah ; from the same as לוּלִים ; properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity.

H3918.d: from לוּשׁ in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows).

H3919.d: the same as לַ֫יִשׁ ; Laish, the name of two places in Palestine. Compare לוּשׁ .

H3920.d: a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere.
H3920.k: X at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take

H3921.d: from לָכַד ; something to capture with, i.e. a noose.

H3922.d: from יָלַך ; a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine: -Lecah.

H3923.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine.

H3924.d: from the same as לוּלִים ; a loop.

H3925.d: a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive):(un-) accustomed, X diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, - ing).

H3926.d: a prol. and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for.

H3927.d: or Lmow el ; from לְמוֹ and אֵל ; (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon: -Lemuel.

H3928.d: or limmud ; from לָמַד ; instructed: -accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs.

H3932.d: a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly.
H3932.k: have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering

H3934.d: from לָעַג ; a buffoon; also a foreigner.

H3935.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite.

H3936.d: from the same as לַעְדָּה ; Ladan, the name of two Israelites.

H3937.d: a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue: -strange language.

H3938.d: a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed.

H3939.d: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed).

H3940.d: or lappid ; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame.

H3941.d: feminine plural of לַפִּיד ; Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah.

H3942.d: from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and פָּנִים ; anterior.

H3943.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside.

H3946.d: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine.

H3947.d: a primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications).
H3947.k: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, X many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win

H3948.d: from לָקַח ; properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement.

H3949.d: from לָקַח ; learned; Likchi, an Israelite.

H3950.d: a primitive root; properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean.

H3952.d: a primitive root; to lick or lap.

H3953.d: a primitive root; to gather the after crop.

H3955.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e. (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake.

H3956.d: or lashon ; also (in plural) feminine lshonah ; from לָשַׁן ; the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water).
H3956.k: + babbler,bay, + evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge

H3957.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging). Compare נִשְׁכָּה .

H3958.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth.

H3959.d: the same as לֶ֫שֶׁם ; Leshem, a place in Palestine: -Leshem.

H3960.d: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from לָשׁוֹן ; to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate.

H3961.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לָשׁוֹן ; speech, i.e. a nation.

H3962.d: from an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring; Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan.

H3963.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a measure for things dry.

H3966.d: from the same as אוּד ; properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated).
H3966.k: diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), X louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very (+ much, sore), well

H3967.d: or metyah ; properly, a primitive numeral; a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction.

H3968.d: the same as NONE ; Meah, a tower in Jerusalem.

H3971.d: usually muwm ; as if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning to stain; a blemish (physically or morally).

H3972.d: apparently a form of מְאוּם ; properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing.

H3974.d: or maor ; also (in plural) feminine mpowrah ; or morah ; from אוֹר ; properly, a luminous body or luminary, i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element): figuratively, brightness, i.e.cheerfulness; specifically, a chandelier.

H3975.d: feminine passive participle of אוֹר ; something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent).

H3976.d: from אָזַן ; (only in the dual) a pair of scales: -balances.

H3978.d: from אָכַל ; an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit).

H3979.d: from אָכַל ; something to eat with,- i.e. a knife.

H3980.d: from אָכַל ; something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel.

H3982.d: from אָמַר ; something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict.

H3984.d: (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to אָנָה in the sense of an inclosure by sides; a utensil.

H3988.d: a primitive root; to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear.
H3988.k: abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe(some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, X utterly, vile person

H3989.d: from אָפָה ; something baked, i.e. a batch: -baken.

H3990.d: from the same as אָפֵל ; something opaque: -darkness.

H3992.d: a primitive root; to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, i.e. be painful.

H3993.k: lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait

H3995.d: from בָּדַל ; a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place.

H3996.d: from בּוֹא ; an entrance (the place or the act); specifically (with or without שָׁ֫מֶשׁ ) sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards. Compare מוֹבָא .
H3996.k: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, + westward

H3999.d: from יָבַל in the sense of flowing; a deluge: -flood.

H4003.d: from the same as בּוּקָה ; emptiness.

H4004.d: from בָּחַר ; select, i.e. well fortified.

H4006.d: the same as מִבְחָר ; Mibchar, an Israelite.

H4007.d: or mebbat ; from נָבַט ; something expected, i.e. (abstractly) expectation.

H4008.d: from בָּטָא ; a rash utterance (hasty vow)..) uttered (out of).

H4009.d: from בָּטַח ; properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance.

H4012.d: from בָּנָה ; built up; Mebunnai, an Israelite.

H4013.d: also (in plural) feminine (Dan. 11:15) mibtsarah ; from בָּצַר ; a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender.

H4014.d: the same as מִבְצָר ; Mibtsar, an Idumaean.

H4017.d: from the same as בְּשָׂמִים ; fragrant; Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite.

H4019.d: from the same as גָּבִישׁ ; stiffening; Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine.

H4021.d: from the same as גִּבְעָה ; a cap (as hemispherical).

H4022.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent; properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as a product or fruit.

H4023.d: (Zech. 12 or Mgiddow ; from גָּדַד ; rendezvous; Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine.

H4024.d: or Migdol ; probably of Egyptian origin; Migdol, a place in Egypt.

H4025.d: from מֶ֫גֶד and אֵל ; preciousness of God; Magdiel, an Idumaean.

H4026.d: also (in plural) feminine migdalah ; from גָּדַל ; a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers. Compare the names following.

H4027.d: from מִגְדָּל and אֵל ; tower of God; Migdal-El, a place in Palestine.

H4028.d: from מִגְדָּל and גַּד ; tower of Fortune; Migdal-Gad, a place in Palestine.

H4029.d: from מִגְדָּל and עֵ֫דֶר ; tower of a flock; Migdal-Eder, a place in Palestine.

H4030.d: from the same as מֶ֫גֶד ; preciousness, i.e. a gem.

H4031.d: from גּוֹג ; Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region.

H4032.d: or (Lam. 2:22) maguwr ; from גּוּר in the sense of fearing; a fright (objective or subjective). Compare מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב .

H4033.d: or magur ; from גּוּר in the sense of lodging; a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence. Compare מָגוֹר .
H4033.k: dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger

H4035.d: feminine of מָגוֹר or of מָגוּר ; a fright; also a granary.

H4036.d: from מָגוֹר and סָבִיב with the preposition inserted; affright from around; Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur.

H4037.d: from גָּזַר ; a cutting implement, i.e. a blade.

H4038.d: from an unused root meaning to reap; a sickle.

H4041.d: from the same as גַּם ; properly, accumulation, i.e. impulse or direction.

H4042.d: a denominative from מָגֵן ; properly, to shield; encompass with; figuratively, to rescue, to hand safely over (i.e. surrender).

H4043.d: also (in plural) feminine mginnah ; from גָּנַן ; a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile.
H4043.k: X armed, buckler, defence, ruler, + scale, shield

H4044.d: from מָגַן ; a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy. See also מָגֵן .

H4046.d: from נָגַף ; a pestilence; by analogy, defeat.

H4047.d: apparently from גּוּף or נָגַף and עָשׁ ; exterminator of (the) moth; Magpiash, an Israelite.

H4048.d: a primitive root; to yield up; intensively, to precipitate.

H4051.d: from מָגַר ; precipice; Migron, a place in Palestine.

H4052.d: from גָּרַע ; a ledge or offset.

H4053.d: from גָּרַף ; something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod.

H4054.d: also (in plural) feminine (Ezek. 27:28) migrashah ; from גָּרַשׁ ; a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around a building, or the margin of the sea.

H4055.d: or med ; from מָדַד ; properly, extent, i.e. height; also a measure; by implication, a vesture (as measured); also a carpet.
H4055.k: armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature

H4057.d: from דָּבַר in the sense of driving; a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs).

H4058.d: a primitive root: properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended.

H4060.d: feminine of מִדּוֹ ; properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured).
H4060.k: garment, measure(-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide

H4061.d: (Aramaic) or mindah (Aramaic); corresponding to מִדָּה ; tribute in money.

H4062.d: perhaps from the equivalent of דְּהַב ; goldmaking, i.e. exactness.

H4063.d: from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, extent, i.e. measure; by implication, a dress (as measured).

H4066.d: from דִּין ; a contest or quarrel. Compare מִדְוָנִים , מְדָנִים .

H4067.d: from the same as מַדְוֵי ; extensiveness, i.e. height.

H4068.d: the same as מָדוֹן ; Madon, a place in Palestine.

H4069.d: or madduaa ; from מָה and the passive participle of יָדַע ; what (is) known?; i.e. (by implication) (adverbially) why?.

H4070.d: (Aramaic) or mdor (Aramaic); or mdar (Aramaic); from דּוּר ; a dwelling.

H4071.d: or mdurah ; from דּוּר in the sense of accumulation; a pile of fuel.

H4073.d: from דָּחַף ; a push, i.e. ruin.

H4074.d: of foreign derivation; Madai, a country of central Asia.

H4075.d: patrial from NONE ; a Madian or native of Madai.
