H4545.d: from נָסַך in the sense of spreading out; something expanded, i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof).

H4546.d: from סָלַל ; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase.

H4548.d: or micmer ; also (feminine) macmrah ; or micmrah ; or even masmrah (Eccles. 12:11); from סָמַר ; a peg (as bristling from the surface).

H4549.d: a primitive root; to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief).
H4549.k: discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, X utterly

H4550.d: from נָסַע ; a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure).

H4551.d: from נָסַע in the sense of projecting; a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected).

H4554.d: from an unused root meaning to collect; fodder.

H4555.d: from סָפַח ; a veil (as spread out).

H4556.d: from סָפַח ; scruf (as spreading over the surface).

H4557.d: from סָפַר ; a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration.
H4557.k: + abundance, account, X all, X few, (in-)finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, + time

H4558.d: the same as מֶלְקָחַ֫יִם ; number; Mispar, an Israelite. Compare מִסְפֶּ֫רֶת .

H4559.d: feminine of מַלְכוּ ; enumeration; Mispereth, an Israelite. Compare מֶלְתָּחָה .

H4560.d: a primitive root; to sunder, i.e. (transitively) set apart, or (reflex.) apostatize.

H4564.d: from סָתַר ; properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion.

H4565.d: from סָתַר ; properly, a concealer, i.e. a covert.

H4568.d: from עָבָה ; properly, compact (part of soil), i.e. loam.

H4569.d: or feminine mapabarah ; from עָבַר ; a crossing-place (of a river, a ford; of a mountain, a pass); abstractly, a transit, i.e. (figuratively) overwhelming..pass, passage.

H4570.d: or feminine mapgalah ; from the same as עָגֹל ; a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular).

H4572.d: from עָדָה ; ornamental; Maadai, an Israelite.

H4573.d: from עָדָה and יָהּ ; ornament of Jah; Maadjah, an Israelite. Compare מוֹעַדְיָה .

H4574.d: or (feminine) maadannah ; from עָדַן ; a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully).

H4575.d: by transitive from עָנַד ; a bond, i.e. group.

H4577.d: (Aramaic) or m(ae (Aramaic); corresponding to מְעֵי ; only in plural the bowels.

H4578.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be soft; used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extens. the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively).

H4579.d: feminine of מְעֵי ; the belly, i.e. (figuratively) interior.

H4580.d: from עוּג ; a cake of bread (with לַעֲגֵי a table- buffoon, i.e. parasite).

H4581.d: (also mauwz ); or mahoz (also ma,uz ; from עָזַז ; a fortified place; figuratively, a defence.
H4581.k: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), (X most) strong (hold)

H4582.d: from מָעַך ; oppressed; Maok, a Philistine.

H4583.d: or maiyn (1 Chronicles 4:41); from the same as עֹנַת ; an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum).

H4584.d: the same as מָעוֹן ; a residence; Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine. Compare בֵּית בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן , מְעוּנִים .

H4585.d: or msonah ; feminine of מָעוֹן , and meaning the same.

H4586.d: or Msiyniy ; probably patrial from מָעוֹן ; a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural).

H4587.d: plural of מְעוֹנַת ; habitative; Meonothai, an Israelite.

H4588.d: from עוּף in the sense of covering with shade (compare מוּעָף ); darkness.

H4589.d: from עוּר ; nakedness, i.e. (in plural) the pudenda.

H4590.d: or Ma.azyahuw ; probably from עוּז (in the sense of protection) and יָהּ ; rescue of Jah; Maazjah, the name of two Israelites.

H4591.d: a primitive root; properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective).
H4591.k: suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, X borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, (X give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing

H4592.d: or miat ; from מָעַט ; a little or few (often adverbial or compar.).
H4592.k: almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, X very

H4593.d: passive adjective of מָעַט ; thinned (as to the edge), i.e. sharp.

H4596.d: from עָוָה ; a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin (compare עִי ).

H4597.d: probably from מְעֵי ; sympathetic; Maai, an Israelite.

H4598.d: from מָעַל in the sense of covering; a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment).

H4599.d: or ma ynow (Psa. 114:8); or (feminine) ma yanah ; from עַ֫יִן (as a denominative in the sense of a spring); a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction).

H4600.d: a primitive root; to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle.

H4601.d: or Mamakath (Josh. 13:13); from מָעַך ; depression; Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman. See also בֵּית מַעֲכָה .

H4602.d: patrial from מַעֲכָה ; a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah.

H4603.d: a primitive root; properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously.

H4604.k: falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, X very

H4605.d: from עָלָה ; properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
H4605.k: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on (X very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very

H4606.d: (Aramaic) from עֲלַל ; (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun).

H4607.d: from עָלָה ; a raising (of the hands).

H4608.d: from עָלָה ; an elevation, i.e. (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority.
H4608.k: ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs

H4609.d: feminine of מַעֲלֶה ; elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grade-mark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms).
H4609.k: things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story

H4610.d: from מַעֲלֶה and (the plural of) עַקְרָב ; Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert.
H4610.k: Maaleh- accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim

H4611.d: from עָלַל ; an act (good or bad).

H4616.d: from עָנָה ; properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that.. 's sake), + lest, that, to.
H4616.k: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,

H4617.d: from עָנָה ; a reply (favorable or contradictory).

H4618.d: from עָנָה , in the sense of depression or tilling; a furrow.

H4619.d: from עָצָה ; closure; Maats, an Israelite.

H4621.d: from an usused root meaning to hew; an axe.

H4624.d: from an unused root meaning to repress; a parapet.

H4625.d: from עָקַשׁ ; a crook (in a road).

H4626.d: from עָרָה ; a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space.

H4627.d: from עָרַב , in the sense of trading; traffic; by implication, mercantile goods.

H4628.d: or (feminine) maearabah ; from עָרַב , in the sense of shading; the west (as a region of the evening sun).

H4629.d: from עָרָה ; a nude place, i.e. a common.

H4630.d: feminine of מַעֲרֵה ; an open spot.

H4632.d: the same as מְעָרָה ; cave; Mearah, a place in Palestine.

H4633.d: from עָרַך ; an arrangement, i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition.

H4634.d: feminine of מַעַרְכֵי ; an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array.
H4634.k: army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row

H4635.d: from עָרַך ; an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves).

H4636.d: from עָרֹם , in the sense of stripping; bare.

H4638.d: a form of מַעֲרוֹת ; waste; Maarath, a place in Palestine.

H4639.d: from עָשָׂה ; an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property.
H4639.k: act, art, + bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, X well, ((handy-, needle-, net-))work(ing, - manship), wrought

H4640.d: from עָשָׂה ; operative; Maasai, an Israelite.

H4641.d: or Maaseyahuw ; from מַעֲשֶׂה and יָהּ ; work of Jah; Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites.

H4643.d: or maasar ; and (in plural) feminine maasrah ; from עָשָׂר ; a tenth; especially a tithe.

H4644.d: of Egyptian origin: Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt. Compare נֹף .

H4645.d: from פָּגַע ; an object of attack.

H4646.d: from נָפַח ; a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring.

H4647.d: from נָפַח ; the bellows (i.e. blower) of a forge.

H4648.d: or Mphibosheth ; probably from פָּאָה and בֹּ֫שֶׁת ; dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal); Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites.

H4649.d: a plural apparently from נוּף ; wavings; Muppim, an Israelite. Compare שֻׁפִּים .

H4650.d: from פּוּץ ; a breaker, i.e. mallet.

H4651.d: from נָפַל ; a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap.

H4654.d: or mappelah ; from נָפַל ; something fallen, i.e. a ruin.

H4656.d: from פָּלַץ ; a terror, i.e. an idol.

H4657.d: from an unused root meaning to balance; a poising.

H4658.d: from נָפַל ; fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase.

H4659.d: or (feminine) miph.alah ; from פָּעַל ; a performance.

H4660.d: from נָפַץ ; a smiting to pieces.

H4661.d: from נָפַץ ; a smiter, i.e. a war club.

H4662.d: from פָּקַד ; an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census.

H4663.d: the same as מִפְקָד ; assignment; Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem.

H4664.d: from פָּרַץ ; a break (in the shore), i.e. a haven.

H4665.d: from פָּרַק ; properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck.

H4666.d: from פָּרַשׂ ; an expansion..spreadest forth, spreading.

H4667.d: from פָּשַׂע ; a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch.

H4668.d: from פָּתַח ; an opener, i.e. a key.

H4669.d: from פָּתַח ; an aperture, i.e. (figuratively) utterance.

H4670.d: from the same as פָּ֫תֶן ; a stretcher, i.e. a sill.

H4671.d: or mowts (Zephaniah 2:2); from מִיץ ; chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose).

H4672.d: a primitive root; properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present.
H4672.k: + be able, befall, being, catch, X certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), X have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-)on, meet (with), X occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on

H4673.d: from נָצַב ; a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post..stood.

H4674.d: from נָצַב ; a station, i.e. military post.

H4675.d: or mitstsabah ; feminine of מַצָּב ; a military guard.

H4676.d: feminine (causatively) participle of נָצַב ; something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol.

H4677.d: apparently from מָצָא and יָהּ ; found of Jah; Metsobajah, a place in Palestine.

H4678.d: from נָצַב ; something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of a tree.

H4679.d: or mtsad ; or (feminine) mtsadah ; from צוּד ; a fastness (as a covert of ambush).

H4680.d: a primitive root; to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out.

H4681.d: active participle feminine of מָצָה ; drained; Motsah, a place in Palestine.

H4682.d: from מָצַץ in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness; properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used).

H4684.d: from צָהַל ; a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust).

H4685.d: or (feminine) mtsowdah ; or mtsodah ; from צוּד ; a net (for capturing animals or fishes).
H4685.k: also (by interchange for mtsad ) a fastness or (beseiging) tower:--bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare

H4686.d: or (feminine) mtsuwdah ; or mtsudah ; for מְצוֹד ; a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness; --castle, defense, fort(-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.

H4687.d: from צָוָה ; a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law).

H4688.d: or mtsolah ; also mtsuwlah ; or mtsulah ; from the same as צוּלָה ; a deep place (of water or mud).

H4689.d: from צוּק ; a narrow place, i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability.

H4690.d: or matsuq ; from צוּק ; something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop.

H4691.d: or mtsuqah ; feminine of מָצוּק ; narrowness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble.

H4692.d: or matsuwr ; from צוּר ; something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness.
H4692.k: besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower

H4693.d: the same as מָצוֹר in the sense of a limit; Egypt (as the border of Palestine).

H4694.d: or mtsurah ; feminine of מָצוֹר ; a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification.

H4696.d: from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous; the forehead (as open and prominent).

H4697.d: from the same as מֵ֫צַח ; a shin-piece of armor (as prominent), only plural.

H4698.d: from צָלַל ; a tinkler, i.e. a bell.

H4700.d: from צָלַל ; (only dual) double tinklers, i.e. cymbals.

H4701.d: from צָנַף ; a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest).

H4703.d: from צָעַד ; a step; figuratively, companionship.

H4704.d: feminine of מִצְעָר ; properly, littleness; concretely, diminutive.

H4705.d: from צָעַר ; petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time).

H4706.d: the same as מִצְעָר ; Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon.

H4707.d: from צָפָה ; an observatory, especially for military purposes.

H4708.d: the same as מִצְפֶּה ; Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine. Compare מִצְפָּה .

H4709.d: feminine of מִצְפֶּה ; Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of מִצְפֶּה when "in pause".)

H4710.d: from צָפַן ; a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure).

H4712.d: from קֵבָה ; something tight, i.e. (figuratively) trouble.

H4713.d: from מִצְרָ֫יִם ; a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim.

H4714.d: dual of מָצוֹר ; Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt.

H4716.d: from מָקַק ; properly, a melting, i.e. putridity.

H4717.d: from נָקַב ; properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing).

H4718.d: from נָקַב ; properly, a perforator, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, i.e. a quarry.

H4719.d: from the same as נָקֹד in the denominative sense of herding (compare נֹקֵד ); fold; Makkedah, a place in Palestine.

H4720.d: or miqqdash (Exod. 15:17); from קָדַשׁ ; a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum.
H4720.k: chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary

H4721.d: or (feminine) maqhelah ; from קָהַל ; an assembly.

H4722.d: plural of מַקְהֵלִים (feminine); assemblies; Makheloth, a place in the Desert.

H4723.d: or miqveh (1 Kings 10:28); or miqvet (2 Chron. 1:16); from קָוָה ; something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove.
H4723.k: abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool

H4724.d: feminine of מִקְוֶה ; a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir.

H4725.d: or maqom ; also (feminine) mqowmah ; or mqomah ; from קוּם ; properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind).
H4725.k: country, X home, X open, place, room, space, X whither(-soever)

H4726.d: or maqor ; from קוּר ; properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny).

H4728.d: from לָקַח ; something received, i.e. merchandise (purchased).

H4729.d: from קָטַר ; something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place..upon.

H4730.d: feminine of מִקְטַר ; something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan.

H4731.d: or (feminine) maqqlah ; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate; a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining).

H4732.d: (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) מַקֵּל ; rods; Mikloth, a place in the Desert.

H4733.d: from קָלַט in the sense of taking in; an asylum (as a receptacle).

H4734.d: from קָלַע ; a sculpture (probably in bas-relief).

H4735.d: from קָנָה ; something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition.
H4735.k: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance

H4736.d: feminine of מִקְנֶה ; properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid.
H4736.k: (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase

H4737.d: from מִקְנֶה and יָהּ ; possession of Jah; Miknejah, an Israelite.

H4739.d: from קָצַץ ; end; Makats, a place in Palestine.

H4740.d: or maqtsoa ; or (feminine) maqtso-ah ; from קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle or recess.

H4741.d: from קָצַע ; a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel.

H4742.d: from קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle.

H4743.d: ' a primitive root; to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish.
H4743.k: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away

H4744.d: from קָרָא ; something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal.

H4745.d: from קָרָה ; something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune.
H4745.k: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth)

H4746.d: from קָרָה ; properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers).

H4747.d: from the same as קַר ; a cooling off.

H4748.d: from קָשָׁה in the sense of knotting up round and hard; something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses).

H4749.d: feminine of מִקְשֶׁה ; rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse).
H4749.k: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece

H4750.d: denominative from קִשֻּׁאּים ; literally, a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch.

H4751.d: or (feminine) marah ; from מָרַר ; bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly.
H4751.k: + angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, X great, heavy

H4752.d: from מָרַר in its original sense of distillation; a drop.

H4753.d: or mowr ; from מָרַר ; myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter).

H4754.d: a primitive root; to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running).

H4755.d: for מָר feminine; bitter; Mara, a symbolic name of Naomi.

H4756.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרָא in the sense of domineering; a master.

H4757.d: of foreign derivation; Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king. Compare מְרֹדָך .

H4758.d: from רָאָה ; a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision.
H4758.k: X apparently, appearance(-reth), X as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision

H4759.d: feminine of מַרְאֶה ; a vision; also (causatively) a mirror.

H4760.d: apparently feminine passive causative participle of רָאָה ; something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of a bird (from its prominence).

H4761.d: denominative from רֹאשׁ ; properly, headship, i.e. (plural for collective) dominion.

H4762.d: or Mareshah ; formed like מַרְאֲשׁוֹת ; summit; Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine.

H4763.d: formed like מַרְאֲשׁוֹת ; properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow). Compare מַרְגְּלֹת .

H4764.d: from רָבַב ; increase; Merab, a daughter of Saul.

H4766.d: from רָבָה ; properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly.

H4767.d: from רָבָה ; abundance, i.e. a great quantity.

H4768.d: from רָבָה ; a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital).

H4769.d: from רָבַץ ; a reclining place, i.e. fold (for flocks).
H4769.k: couching place, place to lie down

H4770.d: from an unused root meaning to tie up; a stall (for cattle).

H4772.d: denominative from רָ֫גֶל ; (plural for collective) a footpiece, i.e. (adverbially) at the foot, or (direct.) the foot itself. Compare מְרַאֲשׁוֹת .

H4776.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרַד ; rebellion.

H4778.d: the same as מֶ֫רֶד ; Mered, an Israelite.

H4779.d: (Aramaic) from the same as מְרַד ; rebellious.

H4781.d: of foreign derivation; Merodak, a Babylonian idol. Compare NONE .

H4782.d: of foreign derivation; Mordecai, an Israelite.

H4784.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke).
H4784.k: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious)

H4785.d: the same as מָר feminine; bitter; Marah, a place in the Desert.

H4788.d: from רוּד in the sense of maltreatment; an outcast; (abstractly) destitution.

H4789.d: of uncertain derivation; Meroz, a place in Palestine.

H4791.d: from רוּם ; altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft).
H4791.k: (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward

H4792.d: formed like מָרוֹם ; height; Merom, a lake in Palestine.

H4793.d: from רוּץ ; a run (the trial of speed).

H4794.d: or mrutsah ; feminine of מֵרוֹץ ; a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress. Compare מְרֻצָה .

H4795.d: from מָרַק ; properly, rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery).

H4796.d: plural of מָר feminine; bitter springs; Maroth, a place in Palestine.

H4797.d: from an unused root meaning to scream; a cry, i.e. (of job), a revel.

H4798.d: formed like מִרְזַח ; a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation.

H4799.d: a primitive root; properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient.

H4800.d: from רָחַב ; enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty).

H4801.d: from רָחַק ; remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar. See also בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק .

H4803.d: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen.
H4803.k: bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair)

H4804.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָרַט ; to pull off.

H4805.d: from מָרָה ; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) rebellion; concretely, bitter, or rebellious.

H4806.d: from מָרָא in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare מָרֵא ); stall-fed; often (as noun) a beeve.

H4807.d: from רִיב and בַּ֫עַל ; quarreller of Baal, Merib-Baal, an epithet of Gideon. Compare מְרִי בַּ֫עַל .

H4809.d: the same as מְרִיבָה ; Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert.

H4810.d: from מֶ֫רִי and בַּ֫עַל ; rebellion of (i.e. against) Baal; Meri-Baal, an epithet of Gideon. Compare מְרִיב בַּ֫עַל .

H4811.d: from מָרָה ; rebellion; Merajah, an Israelite. Compare יִמְרָה .

H4812.d: plural of מְרָיָה ; rebellious; Merajoth, the name of two Israelites.

H4813.d: from מֶ֫רִי ; rebelliously; Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses.

H4816.d: perhaps from רָכַך ; softness, i.e. (figuratively) fear.

H4817.d: from רָכַב ; a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle).

H4818.d: feminine of מֶרְכָּב ; a chariot. See also בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת .

H4820.d: from רָמָה in the sense of deceiving; fraud.
H4820.k: craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery

H4821.d: the same as מִרְמָה ; Mirmah, an Israelite.

H4822.d: plural from רוּם ; heights; Meremoth, the name of two Israelites.

H4823.d: from רָמַס ; abasement (the act or the thing).

H4824.d: patrial from an unused noun; a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.

H4825.d: of foreign derivation; Meres, a Persian.

H4826.d: of foreign derivation; Marsena, a Persian.

H4827.d: from רָעַע ; used as (abstract) noun, wickedness.

H4828.d: from רָעָה in the sense of companionship; a friend.

H4829.d: from רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals.

H4830.d: from רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasturage; concretely, a flock.

H4831.d: from רָעַל ; perhaps, earthquake; Maralah, a place in Palestine.

H4832.d: from רָפָא ; properly, curative, i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity.

H4834.d: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to be pungent or vehement; to irritate.

H4835.d: from רָצַץ ; oppression. See also מְרוּצָה .

H4838.d: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to sharpen; also to rinse.

H4839.d: from מָרַק ; soup (as if a rinsing). See also פְּרַק .

H4841.d: feminine of מֶרְקָחִים ; abstractly, a seasoning (with spicery); concretely, an unguent-kettle (for preparing spiced oil).

H4842.d: from רָקַח ; an aromatic unguent; also an unguent-pot.
H4842.k: prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment

H4843.d: a primitive root; properly, to trickle (see מַר ); but used only as a denominative from מָר ; to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively).
H4843.k: (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, - ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex

H4844.d: or mrowr ; from מָרַר ; a bitter herb.

H4846.d: or mrowrah ; from מָרַר ; properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent).

H4847.d: from מָרַר ; bitter; Merari, an Israelite. See also מְרָרִי .

H4848.d: from מְרָרִי ; a Merarite (collectively), or decendants of Merari.

H4849.d: from רָשַׁע ; a female wicked doer.

H4850.d: dual of מָר feminine; double bitterness; Merathajim, an epithet of Babylon.

H4851.d: of foreign derivation; Mash, a son of Aram, and the people descended from him.

H4852.d: of foreign derivation; Mesha, a place in Arabia.

H4853.d: from נָשָׂא ; a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly a doom, especially singing; mental, desire.
H4853.k: burden, carry away, prophecy, X they set, song, tribute

H4854.d: the same as מַשָּׂא ; burden; Massa, a son of Ishmael.

H4855.d: from נָשָׁה ; a loan; by implication, interest on a debt.

H4856.d: from נָשָׂא ; partiality (as a lifting up).

H4857.d: from שָׁאַב ; a trough for cattle to drink from.

H4858.d: from נָשָׂא ; a conflagration (from the rising of smoke).

H4861.d: from שָׁאַל ; request; Mishal, a place in Palestine. Compare מָשָׁל .

H4863.d: from שָׁאַר in the original sense of swelling; a kneading-trough (in which the dough rises).

H4864.d: from נָשָׂא ; properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden).
H4864.k: burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward

H4865.d: from שָׁבַץ ; a brocade; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of a gem.

H4866.d: from שָׁבַר ; the orifice of the womb (from which the fetus breaks forth).

H4867.d: from שָׁבַר ; a breaker (of the sea).

H4869.d: from שָׂגַב ; properly, a cliff (or other lofty or inaccessible place); abstractly, altitude; figuratively, a refuge.
H4869.k: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab:--Misgab

H4871.d: a primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively).

H4872.d: from מָשָׁה ; drawing out (of the water), i.e. rescued; Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver.

H4875.d: or mshoah ; from the same as שׁוֹאָה ; (a) ruin, abstractly (the act) or concretely (the wreck).

H4876.d: or mashshu ah ; for מְשֹׁאָה ; ruin.

H4877.d: from שׁוּב ; returned; Meshobab, an Israelite.

H4879.d: from an unused root meaning to stray; mistake.

H4880.d: or mishshowt ; from שׁוּט ; an oar.

H4881.d: or msukah ; from שׂוּך ; a hedge.

H4882.d: from an unused root meaning to plunder; spoilation.

H4883.d: from an unused root meaning to rasp; a saw.

H4884.d: from an unused root meaning apparently to divide; a measure (for liquids).

H4885.d: from שׂוּשׂ ; delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling).

H4886.d: a primitive root; to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint.

H4887.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָשַׁח ; oil.

H4888.d: or moshchah ; from מָשַׁח ; unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift.

H4889.d: from שָׁחַת ; destructive, i.e. (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption).
H4889.k: corruption, (to) destroy(-ing), destruction, trap, X utterly

H4891.d: from שָׁחַר in the sense of day breaking; dawn.

H4894.d: or mishtach ; from שָׁטַח ; a spreading-place.

H4895.d: from the same as שֹׁטֵט ; enmity.

H4897.d: from מָשָׁה ; silk (as drawn from the cocoon).

H4898.d: from an equiv. to שְׁזַב and אֵל ; delivered of God; Meshezabel, an Israelite.

H4899.d: from מָשַׁח ; anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah.

H4900.d: a primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.).
H4900.k: draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, X give, handle, make (pro-, sound)long, X sow, scatter, stretch out

H4901.d: from מָשַׁך ; a sowing; also a possession.

H4902.d: the same in form as מֶ֫שֶׁך , but probably of foreign derivation; Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him.

H4904.d: from שָׁכַב ; a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse.

H4905.d: from שָׂכַל ; instructive, i.e. a didactic poem.

H4906.d: from the same as שֶׂ֫כוּ ; a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively, imagination.

H4908.d: from שָׁכַן ; a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls).

H4909.d: from שָׂכַר ; wages or a reward.

H4910.k: (have, make to have) dominion, governor, X indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule(-ing, -r), have power

H4911.d: denominative from מָשָׁל ; to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble.
H4911.k: be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter

H4912.d: apparently from מָשַׁל in some original sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse).

H4913.d: for מִשְׁאָל ; Mashal, a place in Palestine.

H4915.d: (1) from מָשַׁל ; empire; (2) from מָשַׁל ; a parallel.

H4916.d: or mishloach ; also mishlach ; from שָׁלַח ; a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged.
H4916.k: to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set

H4917.d: feminine of מִשְׁלַח ; a mission, i.e. (abstractly) and favorable) release, or (concretely and unfavorable) an army.

H4918.d: from שָׁלַם ; allied; Meshullam, the name of seventeen Israelites.

H4919.d: plural from שָׁלַם ; reconciliations. Compare מְשִׁלֵּמִית .

H4920.d: or Mshelemyahuw ; from שָׁלַם and יָהּ ; ally of Jah; Meshelemjah, an Israelite.

H4921.d: from שָׁלַם ; reconciliation; Meshillemith, an Israelite. Compare מְשִׁלֵּמוֹת .

H4922.d: feminine of מְשֻׁלָּם ; Meshullemeth, an Israelitess.

H4923.d: from שָׁמֵם ; a waste or amazement.

H4924.d: from שָׁמַן ; fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man.

H4925.d: from שָׁמַן ; fatness; Mashmannah, an Israelite.

H4927.d: the same as מִשְׁמַע ; Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite.

H4928.d: feminineal sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as a adae, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4929.d: from שָׁמַר ; a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (fig.); also (as observed) a usage (abstr.), or an example (concr.).
H4929.k: diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch

H4931.d: fem. of מִשְׁמָר ; watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concr.) the sentry, the post; obj. preservation, or (concr.) safe; fig. observance, i.e. (abstr.) duty or (obj.) a usage or party.
H4931.k: charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch

H4932.d: from שָׁנָה ; properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location).
H4932.k: college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much

H4934.d: from the same as שֹׁ֫עַל ; a hollow, i.e. a narrow passage.

H4936.d: apparently from שָׁעָה ; inspection; Misham, an Israelite.

H4937.d: or mishtan ; from שָׁעַן ; a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance.

H4938.d: or mishteneth ; feminine of מַשְׁעֵן ; support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick.

H4940.d: from שָׁפָה (compare שִׁפְחָה ); a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extens. a tribe or people.

H4941.d: from שָׁפַט ; properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style.
H4941.k: + adversary, ceremony, charge, X crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, X worthy, + wrong

H4942.d: from שָׁפָה ; a stall for cattle (only dual).

H4943.d: from an unused root meaning to hold; possession.

H4944.d: from שָׁקַק ; a traversing, i.e. rapid motion.

H4945.d: from שָׁקָה ; properly, causing to drink, i.e. a butler; by implication (intransitively), drink (itself); figuratively, a well-watered region.
H4945.k: butler(-ship), cupbearer, drink(-ing), fat pasture, watered

H4947.d: from שָׁקַף in its original sense of overhanging; a lintel.

H4948.d: from שָׁקַל ; weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act).

H4949.d: or mishqoleth ; feminine of מִשְׁקָל or מַשְׁקוֹף ; a weight, i.e. a plummet (with line attached).

H4950.d: from שָׁקַע ; a settling place (of water), i.e. a pond.

H4952.d: from שָׁרָה in the sense of loosening; maceration, i.e. steeped juice.

H4953.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁרַק ; a (musical) pipe (from its whistling sound).

H4954.d: patrial from an unused noun from an unused root; probably meaning to stretch out; extension; a Mishraite, or inhabitant (collectively) of Mishra.

H4955.d: from שָׂרַף ; combustion, i.e. cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime).

H4956.d: from the plural of מִשְׂרְפוֹת and מָ֫יִם ; burnings of water; Misrephoth-Majim, a place in Palestine.

H4957.d: a form for שֹׂרֵק used denominatively; vineyard; Masrekah, a place in Idumaea.

H4958.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, i.e. hollow out; a pan.

H4959.d: a primitive root; to feel of; by implication, to grope.

H4960.d: from שָׁתָה ; drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast.

H4962.d: from the same as מָתַי ; properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural).
H4962.k: + few, X friends, men, persons, X small

H4963.d: denominative from תֶּ֫בֶן ; straw in the heap.

H4964.d: from an unused root meaning to curb; a bit.

H4965.d: from מֶ֫תֶג and אַמָּה with the art. interposed; bit of the metropolis; Metheg-ha-Ammah, an epithet of Gath.

H4967.d: from מְתִים and אֵל , with the relative interposed; man who (is) of God; Methusael, an antediluvian patriarch.

H4968.d: from מְתִים and שָׁ֫לַח ; man of a dart; Methushelach, an antediluvian patriarch.

H4969.d: a primitive root; to stretch out.

H4970.d: from an unused root meaning to extend; properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative).

H4971.d: or mathkuneth ; from תָּכַן in the transferred sense of measuring; proportion (in size, number or ingredients).

H4972.d: from מָה and תְּלָאָה ; what a trouble!.

H4973.d: contr. from יָלַע ; properly, a biter, i.e. a tooth.

H4975.d: from an unused root meaning to be slender; properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins.

H4977.d: the same as מַתָּן ; Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite.

H4979.d: feminine of מַתָּן ; a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe.

H4980.d: the same as מַתָּנָה ; Mattanah, a place in the Desert.

H4981.d: probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen.

H4982.d: from מַתָּן ; liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites.

H4983.d: or Mattanyahuw ; from מַתָּן and יָהּ ; gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites.

H4984.d: from נָשָׂא ; (used as abstractly) supreme exaltation.

H4985.d: a primitive root; to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet.

H4988.d: from מָתַק ; a dainty, i.e. (generally) food.

H4989.d: feminine of מֹ֫תֶק ; sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert.

H4990.d: of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians.

H4991.d: feminine of מַתָּן abbreviated form; a present.

H4992.d: for מַתִּתְיָה ; gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite.

H4993.d: or Mattithyahuw ; from מַתָּ֫נֶת and יָהּ ; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites.

H4995.d: apparently from נוּא in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly, tough, i.e. uncooked (flesh).

H4996.d: of Egyptian origin; No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt. Compare אָמוֹן .

H4997.d: or noywd ; also (feminine) no)dah ; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids).

H5218.d: or nakat ; from נָכָא ; smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted.

H5219.d: from נְכָאּים ; properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered).

H5220.d: from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring.

H5225.d: from כּוּן ; prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite.

H5233.d: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; treasure.

H5234.d: a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning).

H5235.d: or noker ; from נָכַר ; something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity.

H5236.d: ' from נָכַר ; foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom.

H5237.d: from נֹ֫כֶר (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful).

H5238.d: probably for נְכֹאת ; spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables.

H5239.d: apparently a primitive root; to complete.

H5244.d: feminine from נָמַל ; an ant (probably from its almost bisected form).

H5246.d: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp נִמְרָה and נִמְרִים ); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping; a leopard (from its stripes).

H5249.d: plural of a masculine corresponding to נִמְרָה ; clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan. Compare בֵּית נִמְרָה .

H5250.d: probably from מָשָׁה ; extricated; Nimshi, the (grand-)father of Jehu.

H5251.d: from נָסַס ; a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token.

H5252.d: feminine participle passive of סָבַב ; properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs.

H5253.k: departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away

H5254.d: a primitive root; to test; by implication, to attempt.

H5255.d: a primitive root; to tear away.

H5257.d: from נָסַך ; properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed).

H5263.d: a primitive root; to wane, i.e. be sick.

H5266.d: a primitive root; to go up.

H5268.d: of foreign origin; Nisrok, a Babylonian idol.

H5272.d: from נ֫וּעַ and אֵל ; moved of God; Neiel, a place in Palestine.

H5273.d: from נָעֵם ; delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative).

H5280.d: patronymic from נַעֲמָן ; a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively).

H5281.d: from נֹ֫עַם ; pleasant; Noomi, an Israelitess.

H5283.d: the same as נַעֲמָנִים ; Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene.

H5284.d: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with נַעֲמָה ; a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah.

H5285.d: from an unused root meaning to prick; probably a brier; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes.

H5287.d: a primitive root (probably identical with נָעַר , through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar); to tumble about.

H5289.d: from נָעַר in its derivative sense of tossing about; a wanderer.

H5291.d: feminine of נַ֫עַר ; a girl (from infancy to adolescence).

H5293.d: from נַ֫עַר ; youthful; Naarai, an Israelite.

H5294.d: from נַ֫עַר and יָהּ ; servant of Jah; Nearjah, the name of two Israelites.

H5295.d: from נַ֫עַר ; juvenile; Naaran, a place in Palestine.

H5296.d: from נָעַר ; something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax).

H5297.d: a variation of מֹף ; Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt.

H5298.d: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout; Nepheg, the name of two Israelites.

H5299.d: from נוּף in the sense of lifting; a height; also a sieve.

H5300.d: for נְפִיסִים ; Nephushesim, a Temple- servant.

H5301.d: a primitive root; to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem).

H5302.d: from נָפַח ; a gust; Nophach, a place in Moab.

H5305.d: from נָפַשׁ ; refreshed; Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity.

H5319.d: from פָּתַל ; properly, wrestled; but ued (in the plural) transitively, a struggle.

H5335.d: from נָצַח ; conspicuous; Netsiach, a Temple- servant.

H5336.d: from נָצַר ; properly, conservative; but used passively, delivered.

H5340.d: a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be bright- colored.

H5356.d: or niqqayon ; from נָקָה ; clearness (literally or figuratively).

H5367.d: a primitive root; to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively.

H5369.d: the same as נֵר ; lamp; Ner, an Israelite.

H5370.d: of foreign origin; Nergal, a Cuthite deity.

H5374.d: or Neriyahuw ; from נֵר and יָהּ ; light of Jah; Nerijah, an Israelite.

H5917.d: from עָכַר ; troublesome; Akar, an Israelite. Compare עָכָן .

H5918.d: from עָכַר ; muddler; Okran, an Israelite.

H5919.d: probably from an unused root meaning to coil; an asp (from lurking coiled up).

H5926.d: from an unused root meaning to stutter; stuttering.

H5957.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עוֹלָם ; remote time, i.e. the future or past indefinitely; often adverb, forever.

H5964.d: from עָלַם ; a covering; Alemeth, the name of a place in Palestine and of two Israelites.

H5965.d: a primitive root; to leap for joy, i.e. exult, wave joyously.

H5966.d: a prim root; to sip up.

H5968.d: a primitive root; to veil or cover; figuratively, to be languid.

H5969.d: from עָלַף ; an envelope, i.e. (figuratively) mourning.

H5970.d: a primitive root; to jump for joy, i.e. exult.

H5971.d: from עָמַם ; a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock.

H5973.d: from עָמַם ; adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English).

H5977.d: from עָמַד ; a spot (as being fixed).

H5979.d: from עָמַד ; a station, i.e. domicile.

H5981.d: the same as עֻמַּת ; association; Ummah, a place in Palestine.

H5982.d: or ammud ; from עָמַד ; a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform.

H5983.d: from עָם ; tribal, i.e. inbred; Ammon, a son of Lot; also his posterity and their country.

H5986.d: from עָמַס ; burdensome; Amos, an Israelite prophet.

H5987.d: from עָמַק ; deep; Amok, an Israelite.

H5988.d: from עָם and אֵל ; people of God; Ammiel, the name of three or four Israelites.

H5992.d: from עָם and נָדַב ; people of liberality; Amminadab, the name of four Israelites.

H5998.d: a primitive root; to toil, i.e. work severely and with irksomeness.

H6005.d: from עִם and אֵל with a pronominal suffix inserted; with us (is) God; Immanuel, a type name of Isaiah's son.

H6042.d: from עָנָה ; afflicted; Unni, the name of two Israelites.

H6044.d: for plural of עַ֫יִן ; fountains; Anim, a place in Palestine.

H6047.d: as if plural of some Egyptian word; Anamim, a son of Mizraim and his descendants, with their country.

H6048.d: of foreign origin; Anammelek, an Assyrian deity.

H6049.d: a primitive root; to cover; used only as a denominative from עָנָן , to cloud over; figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. practise magic.

H6051.d: from עָנַן ; a cloud (as covering the sky), i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud.

H6054.d: from עָנָן ; cloudy; Anani, an Israelite.

H6055.d: from עָנַן and יָהּ ; Jah has covered; Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine.

H6057.d: from an unused root meaning to cover; a twig (as covering the limbs).

H6058.d: from the same as עָנָף ; branching.

H6060.d: from עָנַק ; a necklace (as if strangling).

H6061.d: the same as עֲנָק ; Anak, a Canaanite.

H6062.d: patronymically from עֲנָק ; an Anakite or descendant of Anak.

H6063.d: probably for נַ֫עַר ; Aner, a Amorite, also a place in Palestine.

H6064.d: a primitive root; properly, to urge; by implication, to inflict a penalty, specifically, to fine.

H6067.d: from עָנָה ; answer; Anath, an Israelite.

H6068.d: plural of עֲנָת ; Anathoth, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Pal.

H6069.d: or Annthowthiy ; patrial from עֲנָתוֹת ; a Antothite or inhabitant of Anathoth.

H6071.d: from עָסַס ; must or fresh grape-juice (as just trodden out).

H6073.d: from an unused root meaning to cover; a bough (as covering the tree).

H6074.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עֳפָאּים ; a twig; bough, i.e. (collectively) foliage.

H6077.d: the same as עֹ֫פֶל ; Ophel, a ridge in Jerusalem.

H6110.d: feminine of עָצוּם ; a bulwark, i.e. (figuratively) argument.

H6116.d: or matsereth ; from עָצַר ; an assembly, especially on a festival or holiday.

H6120.d: from עָקַב in its denominative sense; a lier in wait.

H6121.d: from עָקַב ; in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense (transitive) fraudulent or (intransitive) tracked.

H6122.d: feminine of an unused form from עָקַב meaning a trick; trickery.

H6123.d: a primitive root; to tie with thongs.

H6126.d: from עָקַב ; insidious; Akkub, the name of five Israelites.

H6130.d: from an unused root meaning to twist; tortuous; Akan, an Idummaean. Compare יַעֲקָן .

H6131.d: a primitive root; to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate.

H6133.d: from עָקַר . figuratively, a transplanted person, i.e. naturalized citizen.

H6134.d: the same as עֵ֫קֶר ; Eker, an Israelite.

H6135.d: from עָקַר ; sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs).

H6137.d: of uncertain derivation; a scorpion; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip.

H6138.d: from עָקַר ; eradication; Ekron, a place in Palestine.

H6139.d: or Eqroniy ; patrial from עֶקְרוֹן ; an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron.

H6140.d: a primitive root; to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse).

H6142.d: the same as עִקֵּשׁ ; perverse; Ikkesh, an Israelite.

H6144.d: the same as עִיר ; a city; Ar, a place in Moab.

H6145.d: from עוּר ; a foe (as watchful for mischief).

H6147.d: from עוּר ; watchful; Er, the name of two Israelites.

H6148.d: a primitive root; to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange).

H6149.d: a primitive root (identical with עָרַב through the idea of close association); to be agreeable.

H6150.d: a primitive root (identical with עָרַב through the idea of covering with a texture); to grow dusky at sundown.

H6152.d: or Arab ; from עָרַב in the figurative sense of sterility; Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine.

H6154.d: or mereb (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article prefix); from עָרַב ; the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race).

H6155.d: from עָרַב ; a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles).

H6157.d: from עָרַב ; a mosquito (from its swarming).

H6158.d: or mowreb ; from עָרַב ; a raven (from its dusky hue).

H6159.d: or Owreb ; the same as עֹרֵב ; Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan.

H6160.d: from עָרַב (in the sense of sterility); a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea. See also בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה .

H6161.d: feminine passive participle of עֲנַמֶּ֫לֶך in the sense of a bargain or exchange; something given as security, i.e. (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman.

H6162.d: from עָרַב (in the sense of exchange); a pawn (given as security).

H6163.d: or Arbiy ; patrial from עֲרָב ; an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia).

H6164.d: patrial from בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה ; an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-)Arabah.

H6165.d: a primitive root; to long for.

H6166.d: from an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive; Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite.

H6168.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish.

H6169.d: feminine from עָרָה ; a naked (i.e. level) plot.

H6170.d: or iarugah ; feminine passive participle of עָרַג ; something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre.

H6171.d: from the same as עֲרָד ; an onager (from his lonesome habits).

H6172.d: from עָרָה ; nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish).

H6173.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עֶרְוָה ; nakedness, i.e. (figuratively) impoverishment.

H6174.d: or marom ; from עָרֹם (in its original sense); nude, either partially or totally.

H6176.d: or sarear ; from עָרַר reduplicated; a juniper (from its nudity of situation).

H6177.d: or `Aro`er ; or `Ar`owr ; the same as עֲרוֹעֵר ; nudity of situation; Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine.

H6178.d: passive participle of עָרַץ ; feared, i.e. (concretely) a horrible place or chasm.

H6179.d: from עוּר ; watchful; Eri, an Israelite.

H6180.d: patronymically of עֵרִי ; a Erite (collectively) or descendants of Eri.

H6182.d: from an unused root meaning to comminute; meal.

H6183.d: from עָרַף ; the sky (as dropping at the horizon).

H6184.d: from עָרַץ ; fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical.

H6185.d: from עָרַר ; bare, i.e. destitute (of children).

H6186.d: a primitive root; to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications).

H6192.d: a primitive root; to pile up.

H6194.d: (Jer. 50:26) or (feminine) aremah ; from עָרַם ; a heap; specifically, a sheaf.

H6195.d: feminine of עֹ֫רֶם ; trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion.

H6196.d: probably from עָרֹם ; the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark).

H6197.d: probably from עוּר ; watchful; Eran, an Israelite.

H6198.d: patronymically from עֵרָן ; an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran.

H6199.d: from עָרַר ; naked, i.e. (figuratively) poor. See also עֲרוֹעֵר .

H6200.d: patronymically from עַרְעוֹר ; an Aroerite or inhabitant of Aroer.

H6201.d: a primitive root; to droop; hence, to drip.

H6202.d: a primitive root (identical with עָרַף through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from עֹ֫רֶף , to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy.

H6203.d: from עָרַף ; the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative).

H6205.d: probably from עָרַף ; gloom (as of a lowering sky).

H6206.d: a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass.
H6206.k: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly

H6207.d: a primitive root; to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain.

H6208.d: patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek.

H6209.d: a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish.
H6209.k: make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), X utterly

H6210.d: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy).

H6211.d: from עָשֵׁשׁ ; a moth. See also עָשׁ .

H6212.d: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot).

H6215.d: apparently a form of the passive participle of עָשָׂה in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt); Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity.

H6216.d: from עָשַׁק ; oppressive (as noun, a tyrant).

H6217.d: or mashuq ; passive participle of עָשַׁק ; used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny. (Doubtful.)

H6218.d: or masor ; from עָ֫שֶׂר ; ten; by abbrev. ten strings, and so a decachord.

H6220.d: for עָשׁוֹת ; bright; Ashvath, an Israelite.

H6221.d: from עָשָׂה and אֵל ; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite.

H6222.d: from עָשָׂה and יָהּ ; Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites.

H6223.d: from עָשַׁר ; rich, whether literal or figurative (noble).

H6224.d: from עָ֫שֶׂר ; tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part.

H6225.d: a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative.

H6227.d: from עָשַׁן ; smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger).

H6229.d: a primitive root (identical with עָשַׁק ); to press upon, i.e. quarrel; --strive with.

H6232.d: from עָשַׁק ; oppression; Eshek, an Israelite.

H6233.d: from עָשַׁק ; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain.

H6235.d: masculine of term aasarah ; from עָשַׂר ; ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits).

H6236.d: (Aramaic) masculine aasrah (Aramaic); corresponding to עָ֫שֶׂר ; ten.

H6237.d: a primitive root (ident. with עָשַׁר ); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from עָ֫שֶׂר ; to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth.

H6241.d: or oissaron ; from עָ֫שֶׂר ; (fractional) a tenth part.

H6244.d: a primitive root; probably to shrink, i.e. fail.

H6253.d: probably for עַשְׁתְּרוֹת ; Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase).

H6255.d: from עַשְׁתָּרוֹת and the dual of קָ֫רֶן ; Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity); Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan.

H6256.d: from עַד ; time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.

H6260.d: or sattud ; from עָתַד ; prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people.

H6264.d: from עָתַד ; prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure.

H6265.d: from עוּת and יָהּ ; Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite.

H6267.d: from עָתַק ; removed, i.e. weaned; also antique.

H6269.d: from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine.

H6270.d: from an unused root meaning to compress; constringent; Athlai, an Israelite.

H6271.d: or Athalyahuw ; from the same as עַתְלָי and יָהּ ; Jah has constrained; Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites.

H6272.d: a primitive root; probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated.

H6273.d: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite.

H6274.d: from the same as עָתְנִי and אֵל ; force of God; Othniel, an Israelite.

H6275.d: a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe.

H6277.d: from עָתַק in the sense of license; impudent.

H6278.d: from עֵת and קַיָּם ; time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine.

H6279.d: a primitive root (rather denominative from עֶ֫תֶר ); to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer).

H6280.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant.

H6281.d: from עָתַר ; abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine.

H6282.d: from עָתַר ; incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence (from עָתַר ) a worshipper.

H6284.d: a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow away.

H6285.d: feminine of NONE ; properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity.

H6286.d: a primitive root; to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; denominative from פֻּארָה , to shake a tree.

H6289.d: from פָּאַר ; properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety).

H6290.d: from פָּאַר ; ornamental; Paran, a desert of Arabia.

H6291.d: from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e. crude; an unripe fig.

H6292.d: or piggul ; from an unused root meaning to stink; properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially).

H6295.d: from פֶּ֫גַע and אֵל ; accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite.

H6296.d: a primitive root; to relax, i.e. become exhausted.

H6297.d: from פָּגַר ; a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image.

H6298.d: a primitive root; to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur.

H6299.d: a primitive root; to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve.
H6299.k: X at all, deliver, X by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, X surely

H6301.d: from פָּדָה and צוּר ; a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite.

H6302.d: passive participle of פָּדָה . ransomed (and so occurring under פָּדָה ); as abstractly (in plural masculine) a ransom.

H6303.d: from פָּדָה ; ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim. -- Padon.

H6304.d: or pduth ; from קֵ֫דְמָה ; distinction; also deliverance.

H6305.d: or Pdayahuw ; from פָּדָה and יָהּ ; Jah has ransomed; Pedajah, the name of six Israelites.

H6306.d: or pidyom ; also pidyown ; or pidyon ; from פָּדָה ; a ransom; --ransom, that were redeemed, redemption.

H6307.d: from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or Paddan Aram ; from the same and אֲרָם ; the table-land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria.

H6309.d: from an unused root meaning to be greasy; suet.

H6313.d: a primitive root; to be sluggish.

H6320.d: from an unused root meaning to paint; dye (specifically, stibium for the eyes).

H6321.d: from an unused root meaning to be thick; a bean (as plump).

H6322.d: of foreign origin; Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe.

H6326.d: from an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy; Puah, an Israelitess.

H6327.d: a primitive root; to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse).

H6612.d: or pethiy ; or pthaeiy ; from פָּתָה ; silly (i.e. seducible).

H6613.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to פָּתָה ; open, i.e. (as noun) width.

H6626.d: a primitive root; to open, i.e. break:--participle

H6628.d: from an unused root meaning to be slender; the lotus tree.

H6631.d: from יָצָא ; issue, i.e. produce, children.

H6633.d: a primitive root; to mass (an army or servants).

H6635.d: or (feminine) tsbadah ; from צָבָא ; a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized for war (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship).

H6640.d: (Aramaic) from צְבָא ; properly, will; concretely, an affair (as a matter of determination).

H6642.d: a primitive root; to grasp, i.e. hand out.

H6649.d: from the same as צֶ֫בַע ; variegated; Tsibon, an Idumaean.

H6653.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to grip; a lock of stalks.

H6657.d: from the same as צַד ; a siding; Tsedad, a place near Palestine.

H6658.d: a primitive root; to chase; by implication, to desolate.

H6661.d: plural of צַד ; sides; Tsiddim (with the article), a place in Palestine.

H6663.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense).

H6664.d: from צָדַק ; the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity.

H6666.d: from צָדַק ; rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity).

H6667.d: or Tsidqiyahuw ; from צֶ֫דֶק and יָהּ ; right of Jah; Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites.

H6671.d: a primitive root; to glisten; used only as denominative from יִצְהָר , to press out oil.

H6680.d: a primitive root; (intensively) to constitute, enjoin.

H6683.d: from an unused root meaning to sink: an abyss (of the sea).

H6684.d: a primitive root; to cover over (the mouth), i.e. to fast.

H6685.d: or tsom ; from from צוּם ; a fast.

H6686.d: from צָעַר ; small; Tsuar, an Israelite.

H6688.d: from צוּף ; comb of honey (from dripping).

H6689.d: or Tsowphay ; or Tsiyph ; from צוּף ; honey-comb; Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine.

H6690.d: from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth; Tsophach, an Israelite.

H6691.d: from צָפַר ; departing; Tsophar, a friend of Job.

H6692.d: a primitive root; to twinkle, i.e. glance; by analogy, to blossom (figuratively, flourish).

H6693.d: a primitive root; to compress, i.e. (figuratively) oppress, distress.

H6694.d: a primitive root (identical with צוּק through the idea of narrowness (of orifice)); to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt, utter.

H6695.d: or (feminine) tsuwqah ; from צוּק ; a strait, i.e. (figuratively) distress.

H6696.d: a primitive root; to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile).

H6698.d: the same as צוּר ; rock; Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite.

H6700.d: from צוּר and אֵל ; rock of God; Tsuriel, an Israelite.

H6701.d: from צוּר and שַׁדָּי ; rock of (the) Almighty; Tsurishaddai, an Israelite.

H6703.d: from צָחַח ; dazzling, i.e. sunny, bright, (figuratively) evident.

H6705.d: a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be dazzling white.

H6708.d: from צְחִ֫יחַ ; bare spot, i.e. in the glaring sun.

H6709.d: from an unused root meaning to putrefy; stench.

H6710.d: from צָחַח ; a dry place, i.e. desert.

H6711.d: a primitive root; to laugh outright (in merriment or scorn); by implication, to sport.

H6712.d: from צָחַק ; laughter (in pleasure or derision).

H6713.d: from an unused root meaning to dazzle; sheen, i.e. whiteness.

H6714.d: from the same as צָ֫חַר ; whiteness; Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite. Compare יִצְחָר .

H6715.d: from the same as צָ֫חַר ; white.

H6716.d: from צָוָה ; a ship (as a fixture).

H6717.d: from the same as צוֹבָה ; station; Tsiba, an Israelite.

H6718.d: from a form of צוּד and meaning the same; the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey).

H6720.d: or tsedah ; feminine of צָ֫יִד ; food.

H6721.d: or Tsiydon ; from צוּד in the sense of catching fish; fishery; Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine.

H6722.d: patrial from צִידוֹן ; a Tsidonian or inhabitant of Tsidon.

H6723.d: from an unused root meaning to parch; aridity; concretely, a desert.

H6724.d: from the same as צִיָּה ; a desert.

H6726.d: the same (regularly) as צִיּוּן ; Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem.

H6729.d: from an unused root meaning to confine; the pillory.

H6730.d: from צָעַר ; small; Tsior, a place in Palestine.

H6747.d: from צָלַח ; something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl; figuratively, the bosom.

H6753.d: from צֵ֫לֶל and the active participle of פָּנָה ; shade-facing; Tselelponi, an Israelitess.

H6754.d: from an unused root meaning to shade; a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol.

H6755.d: (Aramaic) or tslem (Aramaic); corresponding to צֶ֫לֶם ; an idolatrous figure.

H6756.d: from צֶ֫לֶם ; shady; Tsalmon, the name of a place in Palestine and of an Israelite.

H6757.d: from צֵל and מָ֫וֶת ; shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity).

H6759.d: from צֵל and מָנַע ; shade has been denied; Tsalmunna, a Midianite.

H6762.d: the same as צֶ֫לַע ; Tsela, a place in Palestine.

H6764.d: from an unused root of unknown meaning; Tsalaph, an Israelite.

H6765.d: from the same as צָלָף and אֶחָד ; Tselophchad, an Israelite.

H6766.d: from צֵל and צַח ; clear shade; Tseltsach, a place in Palestine.

H6769.d: from the feminine of צֵל ; shady; Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites.

H6770.d: a primitive root; to thirst (literally or figuratively).

H6774.d: from צָמֵא ; a thirsty place, i.e. desert.

H6775.d: a primitive root; to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive.

H6777.d: from an unused root meaning to fasten on; a veil.

H6778.d: from צָמַק ; a cake of dried grapes.

H6779.d: a primitive root; to sprout (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative).

H6783.d: or tsmithuth ; from צָמַת ; excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually.

H6784.d: a primitive root; to dry up.

H6785.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be shaggy; wool.

H6786.d: patrial from an unused name of a place in Palestine; a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites.

H6787.d: dual of צָ֫מֶר ; double fleece; Tsemarajim, a place in Palestine.

H6788.d: from the same as צָ֫מֶר ; fleeciness, i.e. foliage.

H6789.d: a primitive root; to extirpate (literally or figuratively).

H6790.d: from an unused root meaning to prick; a crag; Tsin, a part of the Desert.

H6792.d: or tsoneh ; for צֹאן ; a flock.

H6793.d: feminine of צִנִּים ; a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing).

H6794.d: from an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow; a culvert.

H6795.d: a primitive root; to alight; (transitive) to cause to descend, i.e. drive down.

H6796.d: or tsanin ; from the same as צִנִּים ; a thorn.

H6797.d: or tsanowph ; or (feminine) tsaniyphah ; from צָנַף ; a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around).

H6799.d: probably for צַאֲנָן ; Tsenan, a place near Palestine.

H6803.d: from the same as צִנִּים ; a vase (probably a vial tapering at the top).

H6804.d: probably from the same as צִנּוֹר ; a tube.
