G3349.d: from a compound of μετά and a collateral form of αἴρω or perhaps rather ἀήρ (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious).

G3350.d: from a derivative of a compound of μετά and οἶκος ; a change of abode, i.e. (specially), expatriation.

G3351.d: from the same as μετοικεσία ; to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile.

G3353.d: from μετέχω ; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate.

G3354.d: from μέτρον ; to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule); figuratively, to estimate.

G3355.d: from μετρέω ; a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids.

G3356.d: from a compound of the base of μετρίως and πάθος ; to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently).

G3357.d: adverb from a derivative of μέτρον ; moderately, i.e. slightly.

G3358.d: an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree).

G3359.d: from μετά and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance).

G3360.d: or mechris from μῆκος ; as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas ἄχρι refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction).

G3361.d: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas οὐ expresses an absolute denial); (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas οὐ expects an affirmative one)) whether. Often used in compounds in substantially the same relations. See also ἐὰν μή , ἵνα μή , οὐ μή , μῆκος , μηκύνω , μήν , μή0 .
G3361.k: any but (that), X forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not, nothing, that not, un(-taken), without

G3362.d: i.e. ἐάν and μή ; if not, i.e. unless.
G3362.k: X before, but, except, if, no, (if, + whosoever) not

G3363.d: i.e. ἵνα and μή ; in order (or so) that not.

G3364.d: i.e. οὐ and μή ; a double negative strengthening the denial; not at all. Compare μὴ οὐκ .
G3364.k: any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise)

G3365.d: adverb from a compound of μή and amos (somebody); by no means.

G3366.d: from μή and δέ ; but not, not even; in a continued negation, nor.
G3366.k: neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as)

G3367.d: including the irregular feminine medemia , and the neuter meden from μή and εἷς ; not even one (man, woman, thing).
G3367.k: any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay

G3368.d: from μηδέ and ποτέ ; not even ever.

G3369.d: from μηδέ and -πω ; not even yet.

G3370.d: of foreign origin (compare NONE ); a Median, or inhabitant of Media.

G3371.d: from μή and ἔτι ; no further.
G3371.k: any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more

G3372.d: probably akin to μέγας ; length (literally or figuratively) length.

G3373.d: from μῆκος ; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge.

G3375.d: a stronger form of μέν ; a particle of affirmation (only with ἦ ); assuredly.

G3377.d: probably from the same base as μασσάομαι and μνάομαι (i.e. mao, to strive); to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate.

G3378.d: i.e. μή and οὐ ; as interrogative and negative, is it not that?. Compare οὐ μή .

G3379.d: or me pote from μή and ποτέ ; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps).
G3379.k: if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not

G3381.d: or me pos from μή and -πώς ; lest somehow.
G3381.k: lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps)

G3382.d: perhaps a primary word; a thigh.

G3383.d: from μή and τέ ; not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or nor; also, not even.

G3384.d: apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote).

G3385.d: from μή and the neuter of τὶς ; whether at all.
G3385.k: not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question)

G3386.d: from μήτι and γέ ; not at all then, i.e. not to say (the rather still).

G3387.d: or me tis from μή and τὶς ; whether any.
G3387.k: any (sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence)

G3389.d: from μήτηρ and the base of ἅλων ; a mother-thresher, i.e. matricide.

G3390.d: from μήτηρ and πόλις ; a mother city, i.e. "metropolis".

G3391.d: irregular feminine of εἷς ; one or first.
G3391.k: a (certain), + agree, first, one, X other

G3392.d: perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally).

G3397.d: masculine or neuter singular of μικρός (as noun); a small space of time or degree.

G3398.d: including the comparative mikroteros apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity).

G3399.d: of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor.

G3400.d: of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile".

G3401.d: middle voice from mimos (a "mimic"); to imitate.

G3403.d: a prolonged form of μνάομαι (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind.

G3404.d: from a primary misos (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less.

G3406.d: from μισθόω and ἀποδίδωμι ; a renumerator.

G3408.d: apparently a primary word; pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad.

G3409.d: from μισθός ; to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire.

G3411.d: from μισθόω ; a wage-worker (good or bad).

G3412.d: for mutilene (abounding in shellfish); Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos.

G3413.d: of Hebrew origin ( מִיכָאֵל ); Michael, an archangel.

G3414.d: of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight.

G3415.d: middle voice of a derivative of μένω or perhaps of the base of μασσάομαι (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish. Compare μιμνήσκω .
G3415.k: be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance

G3416.d: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian.

G3417.d: from μνάομαι or μιμνήσκω ; recollection; by implication, recital.

G3418.d: from μνάομαι ; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place).

G3419.d: from μνήμη ; a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment).

G3421.d: from a derivative of μνήμη ; to exercise memory, i.e. recollect; by implication, to punish; also to rehearse.

G3422.d: from μνημονεύω ; a reminder (memorandum), i.e. record.

G3423.d: from a derivative of μνάομαι ; to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth.

G3424.d: from μόγις and λαλέω ; hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied).
G3424.k: having an impediment in his speech

G3425.d: adverb from a primary mogos (toil); with difficulty.

G3426.d: of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil).

G3427.d: the simpler form of ἐμοί ; to me.

G3428.d: a prolonged form of the feminine of μοιχός ; an adulteress (literally or figuratively).

G3429.d: from μοιχός ; (middle voice) to commit adultery.

G3432.d: perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively, apostate.

G3433.d: probably by variation for μόγις ; with difficulty.

G3434.d: of Hebrew origin ( מֹ֫לֶך ); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol.

G3436.d: from μολύνω ; a stain; i.e. (figuratively) immorality.

G3437.d: from μέμφομαι ; blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault.

G3438.d: from μένω ; a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place).

G3439.d: from μόνος and γίνομαι ; only-born, i.e. sole.

G3440.d: neuter of μόνος as adverb; merely.

G3441.d: probably from μένω ; remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere.

G3443.d: from μόνος ; to isolate, i.e. bereave.

G3444.d: perhaps from the base of μέρος (through the idea of adjustment of parts); shape; figuratively, nature.

G3445.d: from the same as μορφή ; to fashion (figuratively).

G3446.d: from μορφόω ; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula).

G3447.d: from μόσχος and ποιέω ; to fabricate the image of a bullock.

G3448.d: probably strengthened for oschos (a shoot); a young bullock.

G3449.d: from the base of μόγις ; toil, i.e. (by implication) sadness.

G3450.d: the simpler form of ἐμοῦ ; of me.

G3451.d: from Mousa (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel.

G3452.d: perhaps a primary word; the marrow.

G3453.d: from the base of μυστήριον ; to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach.

G3454.d: perhaps from the same as μυέω (through the idea of tuition); a tale, i.e. fiction ("myth").

G3455.d: from a presumed derivative of muzo ( to "moo"); to bellow (roar).

G3456.d: from a derivative of the base of μυκάομαι (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule.

G3457.d: from μύλος ; belonging to a mill.

G3458.d: probably ultimately from the base of μόλις (through the idea of hardship); a "mill", i.e. (by implication), a grinder (millstone).

G3460.d: of uncertain derivation; Myra, a place in Asia Minor.

G3461.d: from μύριοι ; a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number.

G3462.d: from μύρον ; to apply (perfumed) unguent to.

G3463.d: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many); ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many.

G3464.d: probably of foreign origin (compare מֹר , σμύρνα ); "myrrh", i.e. (by implication) perfumed oil.

G3465.d: of uncertain origin; Mysia, a region of Asia Minor.

G3466.d: from a derivative of muo (to shut the mouth); a secret or "mystery" (through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious rites).

G3467.d: from a compound of the base of μυστήριον and ops (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι ); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly).

G3468.d: from molos ("moil"; probably akin to the base of μόλις ) and probably ops (the face; from ὀπτάνομαι ); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark.

G3469.d: from μῶμος ; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit).

G3470.d: perhaps from μέμφομαι ; a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person.

G3471.d: from μωρός ; to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act) as a simpleton.
G3471.k: become fool, make foolish, lose savour

G3473.d: from a compound of μωρός and λέγω ; silly talk, i.e. buffoonery.

G3474.d: probably from the base of μυστήριον ; dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd.

G3475.d: or Moses , or Mouses of Hebrew origin; ( מֹשֶׁה ); Moseus, Moses, or Mouses (i.e. Mosheh), the Hebrew lawgiver.

G3476.d: of Hebrew origin ( נַחְשׁוֹן ); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an Israelite.

G3477.d: probably of Hebrew origin (compare נֹ֫גַהּ ); Nangæ (i.e. perhaps Nogach), an Israelite.

G3478.d: or Nazaret ; of uncertain derivation; Nazareth or Nazaret, a place in Palestine.

G3479.d: from Ναζαρέθ ; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth.

G3480.d: from Ναζαρέθ ; a Nazoræan, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth; by extension, a Christian.

G3481.d: of Hebrew origin ( נָתָן ); Nathan, an Israelite.

G3482.d: of Hebrew origin ( נְתַנְאֵל ); Nathanaël (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and Christian.

G3483.d: a primary particle of strong affirmation; yes.
G3483.k: even so, surely, truth, verily, yea, yes

G3484.d: probably of Hebrew origin (compare נְאוֹת ); Nain, a place in Palestine.

G3485.d: from a primary naio (to dwell); a fane, shrine, temple. Compare ἱερόν .

G3486.d: of Hebrew origin ( נַחוּם ); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite.

G3488.d: a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a "narcotic"); Narcissus, a Roman.

G3489.d: from a compound of ναῦς and ἄγω ; to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively.

G3490.d: from ναῦς and κλῆρος ("clerk"); a captain.

G3491.d: from nao or neo (to float); a boat (of any size).

G3492.d: from ναῦς ; a boatman, i.e. seaman.

G3493.d: of Hebrew origin ( נָחוֹר ); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham.

G3494.d: from a derivative of νέος ; a youth (up to about forty years).

G3495.d: from the same as νεανίας ; a youth (under forty).

G3496.d: from νέος and πόλις ; new town; Neapolis, a place in Macedonia.

G3497.d: of Hebrew origin ( נַעֲמָן ); Neeman (i.e. Naaman), a Syrian.

G3498.d: from an apparently primary nekus (a corpse); dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun).

G3499.d: from νεκρός ; to deaden, i.e. (figuratively) to subdue.

G3501.d: including the comparative neoteros neh-o'-ter-os; a primary word; "new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate.

G3504.d: from νέος and a derivative of φύω ; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte").

G3505.d: of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor.

G3506.d: apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy), signal.

G3507.d: from νέφος ; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud.

G3508.d: of Hebrew origin ( נַפְתָּלִי ); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine.

G3509.d: apparently a primary word; a cloud.

G3510.d: of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind.

G3511.d: from a form of ναός and koreo (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary.

G3512.d: from the comparative of νέος ; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile.

G3513.d: probably an intensive form of ναί ; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as.

G3514.d: from neo (of like meaning); to spin.

G3515.d: from νήπιος ; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently.

G3516.d: from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and ἔπος ; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian.

G3517.d: apparently from a derivative of the base of ναῦς (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian.

G3518.d: of Hebrew origin ( נֵרִיָּה ); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite.

G3520.d: probably from the base of ναῦς ; an island.

G3521.d: from νηστεύω ; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement.

G3522.d: from νῆστις ; to abstain from food (religiously).

G3523.d: from the inseparable negative particle ne- (not) and ἐσθίω ; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously).

G3524.d: or nephalios from νήφω ; sober, i.e. (figuratively) circumspect.

G3525.d: of uncertain affinity; to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet.

G3526.d: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian.

G3527.d: probably from νικάω ; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian.

G3528.d: from νίκη ; to subdue (literally or figuratively).
G3528.k: conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory

G3529.d: apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success.

G3530.d: from νῖκος and δῆμος ; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite.

G3531.d: from Νικόλαος ; a Nicolaite, i.e. adherent of Nicolaus.

G3532.d: from νῖκος and Λαοδικεύς ; victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a heretic.

G3533.d: from νῖκος and πόλις ; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia.

G3534.d: from νίκη ; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication) triumph.

G3535.d: of Hebrew origin ( NONE ); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria.

G3536.d: from Νινευΐ ; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh.

G3538.d: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially, to perform ablution. Compare λούω .

G3539.d: from νοῦς ; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to comprehend, heed.

G3540.d: from νοιέω ; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself.

G3541.d: of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son.

G3542.d: feminine from the same as νόμος ; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage.

G3543.d: from νόμος ; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard.

G3544.d: from νόμος ; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law.

G3545.d: adverb from a derivative of νόμος ; legitimately (specially, agreeably to the rules of the lists).

G3546.d: from νομίζω ; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma ), i.e. current coin.

G3547.d: from νόμος and διδάσκαλος ; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi.

G3548.d: from νομοθέτης ; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic code).

G3549.d: from νομοθέτης ; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them).

G3550.d: from νόμος and a derivative of τίθημι ; a legislator.

G3551.d: from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle).

G3552.d: from νόσος ; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite) to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon).

G3554.d: of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability).

G3557.d: middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for oneself, i.e. embezzle.

G3558.d: of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the southern quarter itself.

G3559.d: from νοῦς and a derivative of τίθημι ; calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning.

G3560.d: from the same as νουθεσία ; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to caution or reprove gently.

G3561.d: feminine of a compound of νέος and μήν (as noun by implication, of ἡμέρα ); the festival of new moon.

G3562.d: adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of νοῦς and ἔχω ; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently.

G3563.d: probably from the base of γινώσκω ; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning. Compare ψυχή .

G3564.d: probably contracted for a compound of νύμφη and δῶρον ; nymph-given (i.e. -born); Nymphas, a Christian.

G3565.d: from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride; compare Latin " nupto ," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife.

G3566.d: from νύμφη ; a bride-groom (literally or figuratively).

G3568.d: a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate. See also τανῦν , νυνί .
G3568.k: henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time)

G3569.d: or ta nun from neuter plural of ὁ and νῦν ; the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present.

G3570.d: a prolonged form of νῦν for emphasis; just now.

G3572.d: apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge").

G3573.d: from a presumed derivative of νεύω ; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay.

G3574.d: from νύξ and ἡμέρα ; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours.

G3575.d: of Hebrew origin ( נֹ֫חַ ); Noë, (i.e. Noäch), a patriarch.

G3576.d: from a derivative of νόθος ; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or (figuratively) stupid.

G3578.d: from ξένος ; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment.

G3579.d: from ξένος ; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange.

G3580.d: from a compound of ξένος and δέχομαι ; to be hospitable.

G3581.d: apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer.

G3582.d: as if from xeo (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin sextarius , the sixth of a modius, i.e. about a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by analogy, a pitcher).

G3583.d: from ξηρός ; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature.
G3583.k: dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away)

G3584.d: from the base of ξέστης (through the idea of scorching); arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water).

G3586.d: from another form of the base of ξέστης ; timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance.

G3587.d: from a derivative of the same as ξύλον (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair.

G3588.d: including the feminine he , and the neuter to in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom).
G3588.k: the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc

G3591.d: probably from the same as ἀγκάλη ; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance).

G3592.d: including the feminine hede , and the neuter tode from ὁ and δέ ; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun.

G3594.d: from ὁδηγός ; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)).

G3595.d: from ὁδός and ἡγέομαι ; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)).

G3596.d: from a compound of ὁδός and πορεύομαι ; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel.

G3597.d: from the same as ὁδοιπορέω ; travel.

G3598.d: apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means.

G3599.d: perhaps from the base of ἐσθίω ; a "tooth".

G3602.d: from a derivative of the base of δύνω ; moaning, i.e. lamentation.

G3603.d: from the neuter of ὅς and the third person singular present indicative of εἰμί ; which is.
G3603.k: called, which is (make), that is (to say)

G3604.d: of Hebrew origin ( עֻזִּיָּה ); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite.

G3605.d: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor").

G3606.d: from ὅς with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction).

G3607.d: of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail.

G3608.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὀθόνη ; a linen bandage.

G3609.d: from οἶκος ; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent.

G3610.d: from οἰκέω ; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic.

G3611.d: from οἶκος ; to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit. See also οἰκουμένη .

G3612.d: from οἰκέω ; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail.

G3613.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of οἰκέω (equivalent to οἴκημα ); a residence (literally or figuratively).

G3614.d: from οἶκος ; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics).

G3615.d: from οἰκία ; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives.

G3616.d: from οἰκοδεσπότης ; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family.

G3617.d: from οἶκος and δεσπότης ; the head of a family.
G3617.k: goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house

G3618.d: from the same as οἰκοδομή ; to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm.

G3619.d: feminine (abstract) of a compound of οἶκος and the base of δῶμα ; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation.

G3620.d: from the same as οἰκοδομή ; confirmation.

G3621.d: from οἰκονόμος ; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate).

G3622.d: from οἰκονόμος ; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy".

G3623.d: from οἶκος and the base of νόμος ; a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel).

G3624.d: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively).

G3625.d: feminine participle present passive of οἰκέω (as noun, by implication, of γῆ ); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire.

G3626.d: from οἶκος and ouros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper").

G3627.d: also (in certain tenses) prolonged oiktereo from oiktos (pity); to exercise pity.

G3630.d: from οἶνος and a derivative of the alternate of πίνω ; a tippler.

G3631.d: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin ( יָ֫יִן )); "wine" (literally or figuratively).

G3632.d: from οἶνος and a form of the base of φλύαρος ; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness).

G3633.d: or (shorter) oimai middle voice apparently from οἷος ; to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion).

G3634.d: probably akin to ὁ , ὅς , and ὅσος ; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so.
G3634.k: so (as), such as, what (manner of), which

G3635.d: from oknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath).

G3636.d: from ὀκνέω ; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome.

G3637.d: from ὀκτώ and ἡμέρα ; an eight-day old person or act.

G3639.d: from a primary ollumi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment.

G3640.d: from ὀλίγος and πίστις ; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ).

G3641.d: of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat.
G3641.k: + almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while

G3642.d: from ὀλίγος and ψυχή ; little-spirited, i.e. faint-hearted.

G3643.d: from a compound of ὀλίγος and ora ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem.

G3644.d: from ὀλοθρεύω ; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent.

G3645.d: from ὄλεθρος ; to spoil, i.e. slay.

G3646.d: from a derivative of a compound of ὅλος and a derivative of καίω ; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust").

G3647.d: from ὁλόκληρος ; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness.

G3648.d: from ὅλος and κλῆρος ; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body).

G3649.d: a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek.

G3650.d: a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb.
G3650.k: all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole

G3651.d: from ὅλος and τέλος ; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect.

G3652.d: probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian.

G3653.d: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig.

G3654.d: adverb from ὅλος ; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means.

G3655.d: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm.

G3656.d: from ὅμιλος ; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse.

G3657.d: from ὅμιλος ; companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse.

G3658.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and a derivative of the alternate of αἱρέομαι (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude.

G3659.d: from ὀπτάνομαι ; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye.

G3660.d: a prolonged form of a primary, but obsolete omo , for which another prolonged form omoo is used in certain tenses; to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath.

G3661.d: adverb from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ and θυμός ; unanimously.

G3663.d: from ὅμοιος and the alternate of πάσχω ; similarly affected.

G3664.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ ; similar (in appearance or character).

G3666.d: from ὅμοιος ; to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar.

G3667.d: from ὁμοιόω ; a form; abstractly, resemblance.
G3667.k: made like to, likeness, shape, similitude

G3670.d: from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ and λόγος ; to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge.
G3670.k: con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise

G3671.d: from the same as ὁμολογέω ; acknowledgment.

G3672.d: adverb of present passive participle of ὁμολογέω ; confessedly.

G3673.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and τέχνη ; a fellow-artificer.

G3674.d: genitive case of homos (the same; akin to ἅμα ) as adverb; at the same place or time.

G3675.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and φρήν ; like-minded, i.e. harmonious.

G3676.d: adverb from the base of ὁμοῦ ; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still.

G3678.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄνος ; a little ass.

G3679.d: from ὄνειδος ; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt.
G3679.k: cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid

G3681.d: probably akin to the base of ὄνομα ; notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace).

G3682.d: from ὀνίνημι ; profitable; Onesimus, a Christian.

G3683.d: from a derivative of ὀνίνημι and φόρος ; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian.

G3684.d: from ὄνος ; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass).

G3685.d: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (onomai, to slur); for which another prolonged form (onao) is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of ὄνομα through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from.

G3686.d: from a presumed derivative of the base of γινώσκω (compare ὀνίνημι ); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character).

G3687.d: from ὄνομα ; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess.

G3688.d: apparently a primary word; a donkey.

G3689.d: adverb of the oblique cases of ὤν ; really.
G3689.k: certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily

G3690.d: from ὀξύς ; vinegar, i.e. sour wine.

G3691.d: probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid.

G3692.d: probably from ὀπτάνομαι ; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water).

G3693.d: from opis (regard; from ὀπτάνομαι ) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time).

G3694.d: from the same as ὄπισθεν with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun).

G3695.d: from ὅπλον ; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)).

G3696.d: probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war).

G3697.d: from ὅς and ποῖος ; of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent τοιοῦτος of quality).
G3697.k: what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever

G3698.d: from ὅς and ποτέ ; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as.

G3699.d: from ὅς and πού ; what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot.
G3699.k: in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever)

G3700.d: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) optomai ; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of ὁράω ; to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from βλέπω , which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from εἴδω , which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while θεάομαι , and still more emphatically its intensive θεωρέω , signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and σκοπέω a watching from a distance).

G3701.d: from a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι ; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition.

G3702.d: from an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted.

G3703.d: apparently from the base of ὀψέ and ὥρα ; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit.

G3704.d: from ὅς and πῶς ; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual).

G3705.d: from ὁράω ; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural).

G3706.d: from ὁράω ; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance.

G3707.d: from ὁράω ; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen.

G3708.d: properly, to stare at (compare ὀπτάνομαι ), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear.

G3709.d: from ὀρέγομαι ; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment.

G3710.d: from ὀργή ; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated.

G3712.d: from ὀρέγομαι ; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom.

G3713.d: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare ὄρος ); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for).

G3714.d: from ὄρος ; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of χώρα ) the Highlands (of Judæa).

G3715.d: from ὀρέγομαι ; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after.

G3716.d: from a compound of ὀρθός and πούς ; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward.

G3717.d: probably from the base of ὄρος ; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct.

G3718.d: from a compound of ὀρθός and the base of τομώτερος , to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message).

G3719.d: from ὄρθρος ; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes.

G3720.d: from ὄρθρος ; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day).

G3721.d: from ὄρθρος ; in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break.

G3722.d: from the same as ὄρος ; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn.

G3723.d: adverb from ὀρθός ; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally).

G3724.d: from ὅριον ; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify.

G3725.d: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region).

G3726.d: from ὅρκος ; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin.

G3727.d: from herkos (a fence; perhaps akin to ὅριον ); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath).

G3728.d: from a compound of ὅρκος and a derivative of ὀμνύω ; asseveration on oath.

G3729.d: from ὁρμή ; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge.

G3730.d: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset.

G3731.d: from ὁρμή ; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy.

G3732.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄρνις ; a birdling.

G3733.d: probably from a prolonged form of the base of ὄρος ; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl).

G3734.d: from a compound of the base of ὅριον and a derivative of τίθημι ; a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line.

G3735.d: probably from an obsolete oro (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to αἴρω ; compare ὄρνις ); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain).

G3736.d: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig.

G3737.d: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless.

G3738.d: middle voice from orchos (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion).

G3739.d: including feminine he , and neuter ho probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article ὁ ); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that. See also οὗ .
G3739.k: one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc

G3740.d: multiple adverb from ὅς ; how (i.e. with ἄν , so) many times as.

G3741.d: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from δίκαιος , which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from ἱερός , which denotes formal consecration; and from ἅγιος , which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure). 342

G3745.d: by reduplication from ὅς ; as (much, great, long, etc.) as.
G3745.k: all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever)

G3746.d: from ὅς and περ ; who especially.

G3747.d: or contracted ostoun of uncertain affinity; a bone.

G3748.d: including the feminine hetis , and the neuter hoti from ὅς and τὶς ; which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same. Compare ὅτι .
G3748.k: X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever)

G3749.d: from ostrakon ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail.

G3750.d: from a derivative of ὄζω ; smell (the sense).

G3751.d: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power.

G3752.d: from ὅτε and ἄν ; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as.
G3752.k: as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while

G3753.d: from ὅς and τέ ; at which (thing) too, i.e. when.
G3753.k: after (that), as soon as, that, when, while

G3754.d: neuter of ὅστις as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because.
G3754.k: as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why

G3755.d: for the genitive case of ὅστις (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst.

G3756.d: also (before a vowel) ouk , and (before an aspirate) ouch a primary word; the absolute negative (compare μή ) adverb; no or not. See also οὐ μή , μῆκος .
G3756.k: + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but

G3757.d: genitive case of ὅς as adverb; at which place, i.e. where.

G3760.d: adverb from (the feminine) of οὐδείς ; by no means.

G3761.d: from οὐ and δέ ; not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even.
G3761.k: neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as

G3762.d: including feminine oudemia , and neuter ouden from οὐδέ and εἷς ; not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing.
G3762.k: any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought

G3763.d: from οὐδέ and ποτέ ; not even at any time, i.e. never at all.
G3763.k: neither at any time, never, nothing at any time

G3764.d: from οὐδέ and -πω ; not even yet.
G3764.k: as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet

G3765.d: also (separately) ouk eti from οὐ and ἔτι ; not yet, no longer.
G3765.k: after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not)

G3766.d: from οὐ and οὖν ; is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so.

G3767.d: apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly.
G3767.k: and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore

G3768.k: hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet

G3769.d: apparently a primary word; a tail.

G3770.d: from οὐρανός ; celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky.

G3771.d: from οὐρανός and the enclitic of source; from the sky.

G3772.d: perhaps from the same as ὄρος (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity).

G3773.d: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian.

G3774.d: of Hebrew origin ( אוּרִיָּה ); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite.

G3775.d: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally).

G3776.d: from the feminine of ὤν ; substance, i.e. property (possessions).

G3777.d: from οὐ and τέ ; not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even.
G3777.k: neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing

G3778.d: including nominative masculine plural houtoi , nominative feminine singular haute , and nominative feminine plural hautai from the article ὁ and αὐτός ; the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated).
G3778.k: he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who

G3779.d: or (before a vowel houtos adverb from οὗτος ; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows).
G3779.k: after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what

G3781.d: from ὀφείλω ; an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God).

G3782.d: from ὀφείλω ; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty.

G3783.d: from (the alternate of) ὀφείλω ; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault.

G3784.d: or (in certain tenses), its prolonged form opheileo probably from the base of ὄφελος (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty. See also ὄφελον .
G3784.k: behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should

G3785.d: first person singular of a past tense of ὀφείλω ; I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!.

G3786.d: from ophello (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain.

G3787.d: from ὀφθαλμός and δουλεία ; sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness).

G3788.d: from ὀπτάνομαι ; the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance).

G3789.d: probably from ὀπτάνομαι (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan.

G3790.d: perhaps from ὀπτάνομαι (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice.

G3791.d: from ὄχλος ; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass.

G3792.d: from ὄχλος and ποιέω ; to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance.

G3793.d: from a derivative of ἔχω (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot.
G3793.k: company, multitude, number (of people), people, press

G3794.d: from a remote derivative of ἔχω (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument).

G3795.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of ὀπτός ; a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment).

G3796.d: from the same as ὀπίσω (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day.

G3798.d: from ὀψέ ; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve).

G3799.d: from ὀπτάνομαι ; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show.

G3800.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as ὀψάριον ; rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay.

G3801.l: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
G3801.d: or ho en kai or ho erchomenos a phrase combining ὁ with the present participle and imperfect of εἰμί and the present participle of ἔρχομαι by means of καί ; the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. the Eternal, as a divine epithet of Christ.
G3801.k: which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be)

G3803.d: from πήγνυμι ; a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation).

G3804.d: from a presumed derivative of πάθος ; something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence.

G3805.d: from the same as πάθημα ; liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain.

G3806.d: from the alternate of πάσχω ; properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence).

G3807.d: from παῖς and a reduplicated form of ἄγω ; a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue")).

G3808.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of παῖς ; a little boy.

G3809.d: from παιδεύω ; tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction.

G3810.d: from παιδεύω ; a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner.

G3811.d: from παῖς ; to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment).

G3812.d: adverb (of source) from παιδίον ; from infancy.

G3813.d: neuter diminutive of παῖς ; a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian.

G3814.d: feminine diminutive of παῖς ; a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant.

G3815.d: from παῖς ; to sport (as a boy).

G3833.d: from a compound of πᾶς and ὅπλον ; full armor ("panoply").

G3846.d: from παρά and βάλλω ; to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken.

G3872.d: from a compound of παρά and κατατίθημι ; something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust).

G3873.d: from παρά and κεῖμαι ; to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy).

G3876.d: from παρακούω ; inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience.

G3877.d: from παρά and ἀκολουθέω ; to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to.

G3878.d: from παρά and ἀκούω ; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey.

G3879.d: from παρά and κύπτω ; to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within).

G3880.d: from παρά and λαμβάνω ; to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn.

G3881.d: from παρά and the middle voice of λέγω (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past.

G3909.d: from παρά and τυγχάνω ; to chance near, i.e. fall in with.

G3916.d: from παρά and χρῆμα (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e. instantly.

G3941.d: from παρά and οἶκος ; having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident).

G4041.d: from the present participle feminine of a compound of περί and εἰμί ; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own).

G4042.d: from περιέχω ; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed).

G4043.d: from περί and πατέω ; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary).

G4044.d: from περί and the base of πέραν ; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix (figuratively).

G4045.d: from περί and πίπτω ; to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with.

G4046.d: middle voice from περί and ποιέω ; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy).

G4047.d: from περιποιέομαι ; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation.

G4048.d: from περί and ῥήγνυμι ; to tear all around, i.e. completely away.

G4049.d: from περί and σπάω ; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care).

G4051.d: from περισσεύω ; a surplus, or superabundance.
G4051.k: abundance, that was left, over and above

G4052.d: from περισσός ; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel.
G4052.k: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above)

G4053.d: from περί (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with ἐκ ) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence.
G4053.k: exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly)

G4054.d: neuter of περισσότερος (as adverb); in a more superabundant way.
G4054.k: more abundantly, a great deal, far more

G4055.d: comparative of περισσός ; more superabundant (in number, degree or character).

G4056.k: more abundant(-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather

G4057.k: exceedingly, out of measure, the more

G4059.d: from περί and the base of τομώτερος ; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise.

G4060.d: from περί and τίθημι ; to place around; by implication, to present.
G4060.k: bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about

G4061.d: from περιτέμνω ; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively).

G4062.d: from περί and the base of τροπή ; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze.

G4063.d: from περί and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse.

G4064.d: from περί and φέρω ; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither.

G4065.d: from περί and φρονέω ; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn).

G4066.d: from περί and χώρα ; around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with γῆ implied vicinity).
G4066.k: country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about

G4067.d: from a comparative of περί and psao (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum).

G4068.d: middle voice from perperos (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of πέραν ); to boast.

G4069.d: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female.

G4070.d: adverb from πέρας ; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year.

G4071.d: neuter of a derivative of πέτομαι ; a flying animal, i.e. bird.

G4072.d: or prolongation petaomai , or contracted ptaomai middle voice of a primary verb; to fly.

G4073.d: feminine of the same as Πέτρος ; a (mass of) rock (literally or figuratively).

G4074.d: apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than λίθος ); as a name, Petrus, an apostle. Compare Κηφᾶς .

G4075.d: from πέτρα and εἶδος ; rock-like, i.e. rocky.

G4076.d: from πήγνυμι ; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves).

G4077.d: probably from πήγνυμι (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring).

G4078.d: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent).

G4079.d: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of pedon (the blade of an oar; from the same as πέδη ); a "pedal", i.e. helm.

G4080.d: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of πού ; how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity.

G4082.d: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food.

G4083.d: of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit.

G4084.d: probably another form of βιάζω ; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)). Compare πιέζω .
G4084.k: apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take

G4085.d: another form for πιάζω ; to pack.

G4086.d: from a compound of a derivative of πείθω and λόγος ; persuasive language.

G4087.d: from πικρός ; to embitter (literally or figuratively).

G4088.d: from πικρός ; acridity (especially poison), literally or figuratively.

G4089.d: perhaps from πήγνυμι (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent), i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively).

G4090.d: adverb from πικρός ; bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently.

G4091.d: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman.

G4092.d: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary preo which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever).

G4093.d: diminutive of πίναξ ; a tablet (for writing on).

G4094.d: apparently a form of πλάξ ; a plate.

G4095.d: a prolonged form of pio , which (together with another form) poo occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or figuratively).

G4096.d: from pion (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of πίνω through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness).

G4097.d: a reduplicated and prolonged form of prao ; (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); contracted from perao (to traverse; from the base of πέραν ); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively).

G4098.d: a reduplicated and contracted form of peto ; (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); probably akin to πέτομαι through the idea of alighting; to fall (literally or figuratively).

G4099.d: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor.

G4100.d: from πίστις ; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ).
G4100.k: believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with

G4102.d: from πείθω ; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself.

G4103.d: from πείθω ; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively, trustful.

G4105.d: from πλάνη ; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue).
G4105.k: go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way

G4106.d: feminine of πλάνος (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety.

G4107.d: from πλάνος ; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher.

G4108.d: of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

G4109.d: from πλάσσω ; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively).

G4111.d: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate.

G4112.d: from πλάσσω ; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false).

G4113.d: feminine of πλατύς ; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square.

G4115.d: from πλατύς ; to widen (literally or figuratively).

G4116.d: from πλάσσω ; spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. broad.

G4118.d: irregular superlative of πολύς ; the largest number or very large.

G4119.d: or neuter pleion , or pleon comparative of πολύς ; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion.
G4119.k: X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but

G4120.d: a primary word; to twine or braid.

G4121.d: from πλείων ; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound.
G4121.k: abound, abundant, make to increase, have over

G4122.d: from πλεονέκτης ; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach.
G4122.k: get an advantage, defraud, make a gain

G4123.d: from πλείων and ἔχω ; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder).

G4124.d: from πλεονέκτης ; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion.

G4125.d: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side.

G4126.d: another form for pleuo plyoo'-o; which is used as an alternate in certain tenses; probably a form of πλύνω (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel. See also πλήθω .

G4127.d: from πλήσσω ; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity.

G4128.d: from πλήθω ; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace.

G4129.d: from another form of πλῆθος ; to increase (transitively or intransitively).

G4130.d: a prolonged form of a primary pleo (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi); to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time).

G4131.d: from πλήσσω ; a smiter, i.e. pugnacious (quarrelsome).

G4132.d: prolonged from πλήθω ; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet.

G4133.d: from πλείων ; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet.
G4133.k: but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than

G4134.d: from πλήθω ; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete.

G4135.d: from πλήρης and φορέω ; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish.
G4135.k: most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of

G4137.d: from πλήρης ; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.
G4137.k: accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply

G4138.d: from πληρόω ; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period).
G4138.k: which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness

G4139.d: neuter of a derivative of pelas (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend).

G4140.d: from a presumed derivative of πλήθω ; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification.

G4141.d: apparently another form of πλάσσω (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity). Compare τύπτω .

G4142.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of πλοῖον ; a boat.

G4143.d: from πλέω ; a sailer, i.e. vessel.

G4144.d: from πλέω ; a sail, i.e. navigation.

G4145.d: from πλοῦτος ; wealthy; figuratively, abounding with.

G4147.d: from πλουτίζω ; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively).
G4147.k: be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich

G4149.d: from the base of πλήθω ; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment.

G4150.d: a prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. launder clothing. Compare λούω , νίπτω .

G4151.d: from πνέω ; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit. Compare ψυχή .

G4152.d: from πνεῦμα ; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious. Compare ψυχικός .

G4153.d: adverb from πνευματικός ; non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively.

G4154.d: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze. Compare ψύχω .

G4155.d: strengthened from πνέω ; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown).

G4156.d: from πνίγω ; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled).

G4158.d: from πούς and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress ( ἐσθής implied) reaching the ankles.

G4159.d: from the base of πόσις with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause.

G4160.d: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct). Compare πράσσω .
G4160.k: abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield

G4161.d: from ποιέω ; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively).

G4162.d: from ποιέω ; action, i.e. performance (of the law).

G4163.d: from ποιέω ; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.

G4164.d: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character.

G4165.d: from ποιμήν ; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser).

G4166.d: of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively).

G4167.d: contraction from ποιμαίνω ; a flock (literally or figuratively).

G4168.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ποίμνη ; a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers).

G4169.d: from the base of ποῦ and οἷος ; individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one.

G4170.d: from πόλεμος ; to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively).

G4171.d: from pelomai (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series).

G4172.d: probably from the same as πόλεμος , or perhaps from πολύς ; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size).

G4173.d: from πόλις and ἄρχω ; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate.

G4174.d: from πολίτης ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community.

G4175.d: from πολιτεύομαι ; a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively).

G4176.d: middle voice of a derivative of πολίτης ; to behave as a citizen (figuratively).

G4178.d: multiplicative adverb from πολύς ; many times, i.e. frequently.

G4179.d: from πολύς and probably a derivative of πλέκω ; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more.

G4180.d: from a compound of πολύς and λόγος ; loquacity, i.e. prolixity.

G4181.d: adverb from a compound of πολύς and μέρος ; in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal).

G4182.d: from πολύς and ποικίλος ; much variegated, i.e. multifarious.

G4183.d: including the forms from the alternate pollos; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely. Compare πλεῖστος , πλείων .
G4183.k: abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly

G4184.d: from πολύς and σπλάγχνον (figuratively); extremely compassionate.

G4185.d: from πολύς and τέλος ; extremely expensive.
G4185.k: costly, very precious, of great price

G4186.d: from πολύς and τιμή ; extremely valuable.

G4187.d: adverb from a compound of πολύς and τρόπος ; in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form.

G4188.d: from the alternate of πίνω ; a beverage.

G4189.d: from πονηρός ; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins.

G4190.d: from a derivative of πόνος ; hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from κακός , which refers rather to essential character, as well as from σαπρός , which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners. See also πονηρότερος .
G4190.k: bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness)

G4192.d: from the base of πένης ; toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish.

G4193.d: from Πόντος ; a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus.

G4194.d: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman.

G4195.d: of Latin origin; a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor.

G4196.d: of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman.

G4197.d: from πορεύομαι ; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career.

G4198.d: middle voice from a derivative of the same as πεῖρα ; to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.

G4199.d: prolongation from pertho (to sack); to ravage (figuratively).

G4200.d: from a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition).

G4201.d: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman.

G4202.d: from πορνεύω ; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry.

G4203.d: from πόρνη ; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry.

G4204.d: feminine of πόρνος ; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater.

G4205.d: from pernemi (to sell; akin to the base of πιπράσκω ); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine).

G4206.d: adverb from πρό ; forwards, i.e. at a distance. See also πόῤῥωθεν .

G4207.d: from πόῤῥω with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly.

G4208.d: adverb comparative of πόῤῥω ; further, i.e. a greater distance.

G4209.d: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it.

G4210.d: from πορφύρα ; purpureal, i.e. bluish red.

G4211.d: feminine of a compound of πορφύρα and πωλέω ; a female trader in purple cloth.

G4212.d: multiplicative from πόσος ; how many times.

G4213.d: from the alternate of πίνω ; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught.

G4214.d: from an absolute pos (who, what) and ὅς ; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many).

G4215.d: probably from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (compare πότος ); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water.

G4216.d: from ποταμός and a derivative of φορέω ; river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream.

G4217.d: apparently from πότε and the base of ποῦ ; interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort.

G4218.d: from the base of πού and τέ ; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever.
G4218.k: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n-)ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when

G4219.d: from the base of ποῦ and τέ ; interrogative adverb, at what time.

G4220.d: neuter of a comparative of the base of ποῦ ; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that.

G4221.d: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of πίνω ; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate.

G4222.d: from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω ; to furnish drink, irrigate.

G4223.d: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy.

G4224.d: from the alternate of πίνω ; a drinking-bout or carousal.

G4225.d: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete (compare πόσος ); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly.

G4226.d: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as πού used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality.

G4227.d: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian.

G4228.d: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally).

G4229.d: from πράσσω ; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material).

G4230.d: from πραγματεύομαι ; a transaction, i.e. negotiation.

G4231.d: from πρᾶγμα ; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade.

G4232.d: of Latin origin; the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp).

G4233.d: from a derivative of πράσσω ; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector.

G4234.d: from πράσσω ; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function.

G4235.d: a form of πραΰς , used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. humble.

G4236.d: from πρᾷος ; gentleness, by implication, humility.

G4237.d: perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement).

G4238.d: a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from ποιέω , which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally).
G4238.k: commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts

G4239.d: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble. See also πρᾷος .

G4240.d: from πραΰς ; mildness, i.e. (by implication) humility.

G4241.d: apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right).

G4242.d: from πρεσβεύω ; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors).

G4243.d: from the base of πρεσβύτερος ; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher).

G4244.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of πρεσβύτερος ; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery".

G4245.d: comparative of presbus (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter".

G4246.d: from the same as πρεσβύτερος ; an old man.

G4247.d: feminine of πρεσβύτης ; an old woman.

G4248.d: from πρό ; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost.

G4249.d: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two.

G4251.d: of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman. See also Πρίσκιλλα .

G4252.d: diminutive of Πρίσκα ; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman.

G4253.d: a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to. In the comparative, it retains the same significations.

G4254.d: from πρό and ἄγω ; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)).

G4255.d: from πρό and αἱρέομαι ; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend).

G4256.d: from πρό and a derivative of αἰτία ; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge.

G4257.d: from πρό and ἀκούω ; to hear already,i.e. anticipate.

G4258.d: from πρό and ἁμαρτάνω ; to sin previously (to conversion).

G4259.d: neuter of a presumed compound of πρό and αὐλή ; a forecourt, i.e. vestibule (alley-way).

G4260.d: from πρό and the base of βάσις ; to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years).
G4260.k: + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken

G4261.d: from πρό and βάλλω ; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate.

G4262.d: from πρόβατον ; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem.

G4263.d: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of προβαίνω ; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively).

G4264.d: from πρό and a reduplicated form of βιάζω ; to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate.

G4265.d: from πρό and βλέπω ; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance.

G4266.d: from πρό and γίνομαι ; to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired.

G4267.d: from πρό and γινώσκω ; to know beforehand, i.e. foresee.

G4270.d: from πρό and γράφω ; to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe.
G4270.k: before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime)

G4271.d: from πρό and δῆλος ; plain before all men, i.e. obvious.

G4272.d: from πρό and δίδωμι ; to give before the other party has given.

G4273.d: from προδίδωμι (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender.

G4274.d: from the alternate of προτρέχω ; a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor).

G4276.d: from πρό and ἐλπίζω ; to hope in advance of other confirmation.

G4277.d: from πρό and ἔπω ; to say already, to predict. Compare προερέω .

G4278.d: from πρό and ἐνάρχομαι ; to commence already.

G4279.d: middle voice from πρό and ἐπαγγέλλω ; to promise of old.

G4280.d: from πρό and ἐρέω ; used as alternate of προέπω ; to say already, predict.

G4281.d: from πρό and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time).
G4281.k: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on

G4282.d: from πρό and ἑτοιμάζω ; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively).

G4283.d: middle voice from πρό and εὐαγγελίζω ; to announce glad news in advance.

G4284.d: middle voice from πρό and ἔχω ; to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel.

G4285.d: from πρό and ἡγέομαι ; to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference.

G4286.d: from προτίθεμαι ; a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God.

G4287.d: from πρό and a derivative of τίθημι ; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with ἡμέρα implied) a designated day.

G4288.k: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind

G4289.d: from πρό and θυμός ; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity.

G4291.d: from πρό and ἵστημι ; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise.

G4292.d: middle voice from πρό and καλέω ; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate.

G4293.d: from πρό and καταγγέλλω ; to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise.

G4294.d: from πρό and καταρτίζω ; to prepare in advance.

G4295.d: from πρό and κεῖμαι ; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward).

G4296.d: from πρό and κηρύσσω ; to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance.

G4297.d: from προκόπτω ; progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively).

G4298.d: from πρό and κόπτω ; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along).
G4298.k: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax

G4299.d: from a compound of πρό and κρίνω ; a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession.

G4300.d: from πρό and κυρόω ; to ratify previously.

G4301.d: from πρό and λαμβάνω ; to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise.

G4302.d: from πρό and λέγω ; to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn.

G4303.d: from πρό and μαρτύρομαι ; to be a witness in advance i.e. predict.

G4304.d: from πρό and μελετάω ; to premeditate.

G4305.d: from πρό and μεριμνάω ; to care (anxiously) in advance.

G4306.d: from πρό and νοιέω ; to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself).

G4307.d: from προνοέω ; forethought, i.e. provident care or supply.

G4308.d: from πρό and ὁράω ; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view.

G4309.d: from πρό and ὁρίζω ; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine.

G4310.d: from πρό and πάσχω ; to undergo hardship previously.

G4311.d: from πρό and πέμπω ; to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel.
G4311.k: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth

G4312.d: from a compound of πρό and πίπτω ; falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate).

G4313.d: from πρό and πορεύομαι ; to precede (as guide or herald).

G4314.d: a strengthened form of πρό ; a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated). In the comparative case, it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at.
G4314.k: about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in)

G4315.d: from πρό and σάββατον ; a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve. Compare παρασκευή .

G4316.d: from πρός and a derivative of ἀγορά (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name.

G4317.d: from πρός and ἄγω ; to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach.

G4319.d: from πρός and αἰτέω ; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit.

G4320.d: from πρός and ἀναβαίνω ; to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat).

G4321.d: from πρός and ἀναλίσκω ; to expend further.

G4322.d: from πρός and ἀναπληρόω ; to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully.

G4323.d: from πρός and ἀνατίθεμαι ; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult.

G4324.d: from πρός and ἀπειλέω ; to menace additionally. e. threaten further.

G4325.d: from πρός and δαπανάω ; to expend additionally.

G4326.d: from πρός and δέομαι ; to require additionally, i.e. want further.

G4327.d: from πρός and δέχομαι ; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience).

G4328.d: from πρός and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await.
G4328.k: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for

G4329.d: from προσδοκάω ; apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated.

G4330.d: from πρός and ἐάω ; to permit further progress.

G4331.d: from πρός and ἐγγίζω ; to approach near.

G4332.d: from a compound of πρός and the base of ἑδραῖος ; to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant.

G4333.d: from πρός and ἐργάζομαι ; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides.

G4334.d: from πρός and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to.
G4334.k: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto)

G4335.d: from προσεύχομαι ; prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel).

G4336.d: from πρός and εὔχομαι ; to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship.

G4337.d: from πρός and ἔχω ; (figuratively) to hold the mind ( νοῦς implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to.
G4337.k: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard

G4338.d: from πρός and a derivative of ἧλος ; to peg to, i.e. spike fast.

G4339.d: from the alternate of προσέρχομαι ; an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte").

G4340.d: from πρός and καιρός ; for the occasion only, i.e. temporary.
G4340.k: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal

G4341.d: middle voice from πρός and καλέω ; to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite.

G4342.d: from πρός and καρτερέω ; to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor).
G4342.k: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)

G4344.d: neuter of a presumed compound of πρός and κεφαλή ; something for the head, i.e. a cushion.

G4345.d: from πρός and κληρόω ; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with.

G4346.d: from a compound of πρός and κλίνω ; a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism).

G4347.d: from πρός and κολλάω ; to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere.

G4348.d: from προσκόπτω ; a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy.

G4349.d: from προσκόπτω ; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin.
